job.title: Product Specialist [Johor]
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm's Healthcare Division is partnering with an international organisation in the Pharmaceutical sector to hire a Medical Sales Representative. This opportunity is based in Johor, Malaysia.

Position Overview
This role is responsible for driving product sales and building strong relationships with healthcare professionals across the assigned territory.
It plays a key role in expanding market coverage, supporting customer engagement, and achieving sales targets while ensuring compliance with pharmacovigilance and medical information reporting requirements.

Key Responsibilities
• Generate sales and initiate sales activities to achieve proposed sales target.
• Organise appointments and meetings with healthcare professionals.
• Demonstrate/present products to healthcare professionals including doctors, nurses and pharmacists to promote the products and negotiate the price.
• Build relationship with healthcare professionals.
• Maintain existing customers and develop new customers base and new markets.
• Maintain detailed records of customers and updates.
• Attend/organise trade exhibitions, conferences and meetings.
• Review sales performance and prepare reports on a scheduler basis.
• Prepare presentations, slides and materials as required.
• Responsible to report all Adverse Events and Product Quality Complaints received, to the LPVRP and/or Deputy LPVRP within 24 hours of awareness.
• Responsible to report all Medical Information Enquiries received, to the Medical Affairs Advisor within 24 hours of awareness.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Science (preferred) or related studies.
• Minimum 1 year of sales experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.

Technical / Functional Expertise

• Experience in pharmaceutical, healthcare, or medical product sales.
• Ability to conduct product presentations and demonstrations to doctors, nurses, pharmacists, and other healthcare professionals.
• Experience in customer relationship management and territory development.
• Ability to identify and develop new business opportunities and markets.
• Experience maintaining customer records, preparing sales reports, and monitoring sales performance.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word.
• Understanding of pharmacovigilance requirements, including adverse event reporting, product quality complaints, and medical information enquiries.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

• Energetic and self-motivated with the ability to work independently.
• Strong negotiation and commercial skills.
• Good interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.
• Strong communication and presentation skills.
• Results-oriented with a proactive approach to achieving sales targets.
• Team player with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
• Possess own transport and willingness to travel frequently.

job.title: [CONFIDENTIAL] Service Manager (Medical Equipment)
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Healthcare industry to hire a Technical Manager. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The organisation is seeking an experienced technical leader to oversee technical service operations, ensure equipment reliability, and deliver exceptional customer support while maintaining compliance with industry regulations.

Position Overview

Lead the technical service function to ensure the efficient installation, maintenance and repair of medical aesthetic equipment across the organisation.
Drive service excellence, regulatory compliance and team performance to support customer satisfaction and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead, supervise and develop the technical service team, including work allocation, performance reviews, coaching and training.
• Plan and oversee installation, preventive maintenance, calibration, laser alignment and repair activities.
• Manage service schedules and manpower allocation to ensure timely completion of jobs and effective response to equipment breakdowns.
• Provide technical guidance to the team and hands-on support for complex troubleshooting, urgent repairs and escalated customer issues.
• Monitor service quality, response times, recurring equipment faults and customer feedback, and implement improvements.
• Oversee spare parts inventory, warranty claims and the return of defective parts to manufacturers.
• Coordinate with manufacturers on technical issues, product complaints, service procedures and team training.
• Oversee equipment setup and technical support for demonstrations, exhibitions and new installations.
• Manage maintenance service contracts and ensure accurate quotations, service records and administrative documentation.
• Ensure technical matters are properly documented, communicated, tracked and followed through to resolution.
• Review technical service reports and maintain complete equipment maintenance records.
• Ensure all technical activities follow GDPMD guidelines, manufacturer specifications and applicable safety procedures.
• Coordinate with sales, logistics and other departments on equipment delivery, installation and after-sales support.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

• Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Electronic or Mechanical Engineering, or an equivalent qualification.
• At least 5 years of relevant technical service experience, including maintenance and troubleshooting of medical laser or medical aesthetic equipment.
• Experience supervising or leading a technical service team.

Technical / Functional Expertise

• Maintenance and troubleshooting of medical laser or medical aesthetic equipment.
• Strong technical problem-solving skills, with the ability to guide the team through complex troubleshooting and repairs.
• Good planning and organisational skills, including managing service schedules, manpower and spare parts.
• Knowledge of GDPMD requirements and their application to technical service operations.
• Able to communicate effectively with customers, manufacturers and internal stakeholders, and prepare clear technical reports in English.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

• Strong leadership, coaching and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach.
• Able to work independently, prioritise urgent issues and ensure the team completes work within agreed timelines.
• Experience supervising or leading a technical service team.
• Possess a valid driving licence and be willing to travel for customer visits and urgent technical support when required.

job.title: Associate Director Customer Service Excellent
job.description:
Associate Director, Customer Service Excellence (Capability & Quality)

Job Purpose:

Associate Director, Customer Service Excellence leads the transformation of AIA Thailand’s customer service operations — modernizing contact center and non-voice channels, elevating workforce capability, and embedding service governance and quality excellence. The role ensures resilience and readiness for AI-enabled, customer-centric models, while partnering with leadership to balance operational stability with accelerated transformation. By bringing external best practices and coaching internal leaders, the position builds sustainable excellence and strengthens AIA Thailand’s strategic customer agenda

Roles and Responsibilities:

Training Strategy & Capability Development (30%)

  • Establish and execute training strategies supporting call center transformation priorities
  • Develop curricula (onboarding, refresher, advanced skills) across empathy, digital servicing, AI-assisted handling
  • Create structured pathways for omnichannel servicing and automation integration
  • Embed systemic QA feedback into training design for continuous improvement
  • Elevate frontline leadership maturity (TLs, Supervisors, Managers) via coaching and operational leadership standards
  • Strengthen performance management governance across permanent, contract, and outsource teams
  • Drive leadership routines and operational review cadences to improve execution discipline

Service Quality, Governance & Customer Experience (30%)

  • Oversee governance standards ensuring consistent CX across all touchpoints
  • Strengthen QA frameworks, calibration disciplines, and service monitoring mechanisms
  • Translate VoC insights, complaint trends, CSAT findings, and operational data into measurable actions
  • Partner with QA, VoC, and Analytics teams to identify systemic pain points and failure demand
  • Develop customer-centric service protocols, escalation standards, and proactive servicing approaches
  • Ensure operational consistency and change readiness during organizational transitions, migrations, or process transformation

Operational Excellence & Service Transformation (20%)

  • Lead modernization agenda across voice, non-voice, and customer servicing operations
  • Design scalable operating models to improve productivity, CX, service consistency, and efficiency
  • Identify structural gaps and develop sustainable improvement roadmaps aligned with CSM priorities
  • Drive readiness for future-state initiatives (AI-assisted servicing, workflow automation, digital channels)
  • Support long-term redesign of servicing operations to align with evolving customer expectations and “Delight Customer” strategy

Technology & Operational Intelligence Enablement (20%)

  • Partner with business/technology stakeholders to adopt AI-enabled servicing capabilities
  • Operationalize speech analytics, AI-assisted QA, workflow automation, and voicebot optimization
  • Define business requirements and operational use cases for next-gen servicing technologies
  • Ensure processes, leadership readiness, and frontline capability evolve alongside technology transformation
  • Contribute operational expertise to future servicing model design and automation strategies
  • Lead/support high-priority transformation projects and operational improvement initiatives

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Customer Experience, Industrial Engineering, or related field
  • Minimum 12–15 years of leadership experience in contact center operations, customer service management, or large-scale service operations
  • Proven experience leading complex multi-channel customer servicing organizations

Key Responsibilities

Revenue & Sales Strategy

Team Leadership

  • Set individual and clinic-level targets; drive daily/weekly performance reviews.

Performance & Reporting

Cross-functional Collaboration

Qualifications & Experience

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Experience developing and executing regional go-to-market and sales strategies.
  • Strong understanding of sales funnel management, including lead generation, consultation conversion, treatment sign-up, and case conversion.
  • Working knowledge of CRM tools.
  • Competency in sales reporting, analytics, forecasting, KPI tracking, and performance management.
  • Experience managing sales operations across multiple clinics, outlets, or territories.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
  • Effective coaching and mentoring skills, including sales pitch development, objection handling, and consultation-to-close techniques.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with clinic partners, healthcare professionals, and internal stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify performance gaps and implement corrective actions.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.

job.title: AVP - Finance
job.description:
Executive search firm Monroe Consulting Group Philippines is recruiting on behalf of a holdings company. Our respective client is seeking for a AVP Finance who will build and lead the finance governance structure of the organization. The role will provide enterprise-wide financial leadership across utilities, power, agribusiness, manufacturing, refining, and specialty pulp. The role will ensure strong accounting, reporting, treasury, tax, audit, controls, and financial planning practices. This role has an onsite work requirement in Makati City and will be reporting to the company President.

Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Establish and maintain group-wide finance standards while respecting the operational accountability and autonomy of each subsidiary.
  • Provide guidance to subsidiary Finance Heads on key finance matters, including reporting quality, internal controls, treasury discipline, budget governance, and management analysis.
  • Develop a consolidated view of financial performance, cash position, key risks, funding requirements, and investment priorities for the President and Board of Directors.
  • Challenge and validate key financial assumptions before major decisions are finalized, particularly those related to capital expenditures, financing, leases, intercompany arrangements, and expansion initiatives.
  • Strengthen approval processes and financial governance while maintaining an appropriate balance between control, efficiency, and business agility.
  • Establish the group finance governance framework for all subsidiaries, including financial reporting standards, approval controls, budget discipline, treasury policies, and management reporting timelines.
  • Functionally guide the Finance Heads
  • Standardize finance templates across the Group, including monthly financial reports, cash flow forecasts, budget templates, capital expenditure approval papers, project feasibility models, and management dashboards.
  • Serve as the finance adviser of the President and BOD on group wide financial performance, funding risks, profitability, cash position, and investment priorities.
  • Lead the annual budget, forecast, and strategic planning process across all subsidiaries.
  • Review business cases for major investments, including return on investment, payback period, funding source, sensitivity analysis, risk exposure, and cash impact.
  • Review significant accounting judgments, including depreciation, impairment, inventory valuation, provisions, revenue recognition, lease accounting, and project cost capitalization.
  • Oversee compliance with BIR, SEC, local government, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, tax advisers, banks, government agencies, and regulatory bodies where applicable.
  • Design and implement internal financial controls across the Group.
  • Strengthen controls over purchasing, disbursements, collections, inventory, fixed assets, payroll interfaces, intercompany transactions, bank accounts, and petty cash.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in Accountancy or Finance, CPA is required.
  • At least 15 years of experience in finance from holding companies.
  • Strong knowledge of Philippine tax, statutory reporting, audit requirements, accounting standards, and internal controls.
  • Experience managing or functionally supervising Finance Heads, Controllers, Accounting Managers, Treasury Managers, or Finance Business Partners.
  • Strong Excel and financial modelling capability. ERP or accounting system implementation experience is an advantage.
  • Must be comfortable working with Senior Executives/Management

job.title: Country Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Consumer industry to hire a Country Manager. This opportunity is based in Seri Kembangan, Selangor, Malaysia.

Position Overview

The Country Manager is accountable for the overall performance and sustainable growth of the Malaysia business, with full ownership of commercial execution, operational effectiveness and financial outcomes.

The role plays a critical part in translating strategic objectives into measurable business results while ensuring customers receive an integrated and dependable beverage solution.

Key Responsibilities

Country Strategy & Commercial Growth

  • Develop and execute the Malaysia business plan in line with Group strategy, translating priorities into clear targets, initiatives and accountabilities.
  • Own revenue, gross profit and market-share growth across priority B2B segments, including hospitality, workplaces and food service.
  • Strengthen key-account relationships, develop strategic partnerships and build a disciplined sales pipeline.
  • Lead pricing, portfolio, channel and go-to-market decisions within approved Group policies and authority limits.
  • Identify market opportunities and provide timely competitor, customer and category insights to regional teams.

Financial & Business Performance

  • Own the country P&L and annual budget, including revenue, margin, operating expenses, working capital and profitability.
  • Lead monthly business reviews; analyse variances, risks and opportunities and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure reliable sales forecasting and demand planning to support inventory, procurement and cash-flow decisions.
  • Improve commercial discipline through appropriate credit control, contract governance and return-on-investment assessment.

Operations & Customer Experience

  • Ensure effective day-to-day coordination across Sales, Technical Service, Supply Chain, Finance, HR and Administration.
  • Establish service standards and operating rhythms that deliver responsive, consistent customer support.
  • Resolve significant customer or operational issues, escalating material business risks to the Chief Operating Officer.
  • Drive process improvement, productivity and the effective use of systems and data.

People Leadership & Organisation Development

  • Set clear objectives, decision rights and performance expectations for the Malaysia leadership team and employees.
  • Coach and develop managers, strengthen succession pipelines and address performance gaps promptly.
  • Build an accountable, collaborative and customer-focused culture aligned with Group values.
  • Ensure workforce plans and capabilities remain appropriate for the country’s growth priorities.

Governance, Risk & Stakeholder Management

  • Ensure compliance with applicable Malaysian laws, licences, employment requirements, health and safety standards, and Group policies.
  • Maintain effective internal controls and safeguard company assets, inventory, data and reputation.
  • Partner with regional functional leaders and Group management to deliver cross-border initiatives and shared priorities.
  • Represent the company professionally with customers, suppliers, brand principals, industry partners and relevant authorities.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Finance or a related discipline; an MBA or equivalent qualification is advantageous.
  • At least 8 years of progressive commercial or general management experience, including 3 years leading a business unit, country operation or sizeable cross-functional team.
  • Proven ownership of a P&L, annual budgeting, forecasting and delivery of profitable growth.
  • Strong B2B track record in HORECA, food service, FMCG, beverage solutions or equipment distribution; knowledge of Malaysia’s coffee market is advantageous.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Demonstrated ability to lead sales and operations, develop people and manage complex customer and partner relationships.
  • Proven expertise in annual budgeting, forecasting, demand planning and financial performance management.
  • Experience in pricing, portfolio management, channel strategy and go-to-market execution.
  • Strong capability in inventory planning, procurement coordination, credit control and contract governance.
  • Ability to drive process improvement, productivity initiatives and the effective use of systems and data.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Commercially decisive, analytical and hands-on, with strong judgement, integrity and execution discipline.
  • Excellent written and spoken English; proficiency in Bahasa Malaysia and/or Mandarin is advantageous.
  • Strong leadership, coaching and people-development capabilities.
  • Ability to build accountable, collaborative and customer-focused teams.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Willing and able to travel within Malaysia and regionally when required.

job.title: Head of Corporate Communications
job.description:
Our client is seeking an experienced Head of Corporate Communications to lead and strengthen the organisation’s corporate communications and reputation agenda.

This role will work closely with senior management and will be responsible for shaping corporate narratives, managing key stakeholders, strengthening media engagement, and providing strategic communications counsel on business-critical matters.

The ideal candidate combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, with proven experience managing corporate reputation, sensitive issues, executive communications, and internal communications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute strategic corporate communications plans aligned with business objectives.
  • Shape corporate narratives, key messages, positioning, and communication strategies.
  • Advise senior management on corporate reputation, sensitive communications, and stakeholder matters.
  • Lead media relations and maintain strong relationships with relevant media.
  • Manage crisis and issue communications, including response strategies and protocols.
  • Oversee internal and leadership communications, including Town Halls and executive communications.
  • Develop communication guidelines, playbooks, approval processes, and governance frameworks.
  • Manage corporate digital and social media communications.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop the communications team.
  • Monitor communication effectiveness through relevant metrics such as media coverage, share of voice, reach, sentiment, and reputation indicators.

Requirements

  • Minimum 8–10 years of relevant experience in Corporate Communications, Strategic Communications, Corporate Affairs, Public Affairs, Corporate Secretary, or Communications Consultancy.
  • Preferably currently operating at Head, Senior Manager, AVP, VP, or equivalent level.
  • Proven experience working directly with CEO, Board of Directors, or senior management.
  • Demonstrated ownership of a corporate communications function beyond executional PR or marketing activities.
  • Strong experience in media relations, corporate reputation, crisis and issue management, and stakeholder communications.
  • Experience managing and developing a team.
  • Strong understanding of the Indonesian business, economic, political, and media landscape.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.

Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in the following sectors are particularly relevant:

  • Asset / Investment Management
  • Securities
  • Banking
  • Insurance
  • Fintech
  • Other regulated financial institutions

Strong Corporate Communications professionals from reputable communications consultancies or other reputation-sensitive industries may also be considered.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate proven ownership and impact, rather than relying solely on job title or CV descriptions.

Candidates should be able to demonstrate experience in:

  • Personally shaping corporate narratives and key messaging.
  • Advising CEO/BOD or senior management on sensitive communications and reputation matters.
  • Managing significant corporate issues or crises, including specific examples and outcomes.
  • Building and maintaining relevant media relationships.
  • Developing communication guidelines, crisis protocols, spokesperson frameworks, and approval processes.
  • Leading internal and leadership communications initiatives.
  • Delivering measurable communication outcomes.
  • Leading and developing a relatively junior communications team.

Profiles Less Relevant to This Role

The position is not primarily focused on:

  • Product or marketing communications
  • Advertising
  • Events
  • Branding
  • Social media/content production
  • Agency account management without strategic corporate reputation ownership

We are looking for a communications leader who can operate as a strategic advisor to management while remaining hands-on in execution.

The successful candidate will also be expected to drive the modernization of the audit function through technology, data analytics, and risk-based audit methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and oversee the organization's Internal Audit function, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and follow-through.

  • Provide recommendations to strengthen internal controls, risk management, compliance, and governance practices.
  • Drive continuous improvement and modernization of the audit function through technology, data analytics, and other emerging tools.
  • Partner with senior stakeholders to ensure timely resolution and implementation of audit recommendations.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop the Internal Audit team.

Key Qualifications

  • 20–25+ years of overall professional experience, with preferably 15+ years in Internal Audit and/or Audit leadership.
  • Extensive experience in Internal Audit leadership. Candidates from Financial Services, including insurance, HMO, mutual benefits, or related industries, are highly preferred.
  • Candidates from other industries may also be considered, particularly those with experience in multinational or medium-sized organizations.
  • Strong experience in governance, risk management, compliance, and internal controls.
  • Proven exposure to Fraud, Data Privacy/Data Protection, and Financial/Finance-related audits.
  • Strong experience working with senior management, Board members, and/or Audit Committees.
  • Background in Big 4 firms, consulting, and/or Internal Audit is highly relevant.
  • Experience in technology-enabled auditing and data analytics is an advantage.
  • CPA is an advantage but not required.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
  • Willing to work onsite in Diliman, Quezon City.

job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group Philippines, an executive search and recruitment firm, is recruiting on behalf of a leading global company in optical and medical technology. Our client is seeking a PDC (Practice Development Consulting) Specialist to join their growing team in the Philippines.

The PDC Specialist will serve as a practice development and business performance advisor to clinics, helping improve patient journey, conversion, counselling effectiveness, and overall clinic performance. The role will work closely with clinics and frontline teams to identify business gaps, develop customized growth strategies, and support the successful implementation of the client's solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
Practice Consulting & Business Performance Advisory

  • Conduct structured clinic audits covering the patient journey, conversion funnel, and clinic workflows.
  • Identify gaps in lead management, counselling, and patient experience.
  • Provide data-driven recommendations and customized growth plans with clear KPIs.
  • Act as a strategic advisor to support long-term clinic growth.

PDC Strategy & Market Deployment

  • Identify and prioritize high-potential clinics for targeted intervention.
  • Align PDC programs with SMILE PRO and PRESBYOND growth strategies.

Conversion Excellence & Patient Journey Optimization

  • Drive end-to-end conversion improvements, from lead generation through surgery.
  • Improve appointment booking and consultation effectiveness.
  • Optimize the in-clinic patient journey to minimize patient drop-offs.

Counselling Excellence & Capability Building

  • Design and deliver training programs for counsellors, optometrists, and call center teams.
  • Enhance communication, objection handling, and patient expectation management.
  • Foster a “first procedure of choice” mindset among relevant stakeholders.

In-Clinic Branding, Tools & Materials

  • Develop in-clinic tools, scripts, and educational materials.
  • Simplify refractive concepts to make them easier for patients to understand.
  • Ensure consistent in-clinic branding and communication for the solutions.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Optometry, Health Sciences, Healthcare Management, or any related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, medical devices, ophthalmology, or clinic/practice management.
  • Proven experience in at least one of the following areas:
  • Practice development or clinic consulting
  • Sales enablement or commercial excellence
  • Patient journey, clinic management, or customer experience

job.title: Finance Transformation Consultant/Senior Consultant
job.description:
Shohri Strategy & Consulting
About Shohri
Shohri Strategy & Consulting is a strategy and transformation advisory firm established in
2023 to help organizations create meaningful, measurable impact. Shohri Thailand,
launched in April 2026, serves as the Southeast Asia headquarters of Shohri Strategy &
Consulting Co., Ltd., supporting clients across the region as they transform how they
operate, grow, and compete.
Our people bring experience from leading advisory firms and work together as a small,
highly capable team — collaborating across disciplines, without hierarchy or internal
politics, to solve complex business challenges. This lean, shoulder-to-shoulder structure
keeps us fast, realistic, and flexible, allowing us to combine industry insight, technology
knowledge, and practical execution to help clients move from strategy to results.
By bringing proven solutions and leading practices from Japan into Thailand and Southeast
Asia, and by partnering with technology providers locally and globally, we help clients build
future-ready capabilities that are practical, scalable, and sustainable.
Who We Are Looking For
We're looking for curious, practical, and collaborative people who enjoy working through
complex challenges with teammates and clients. You don't need every answer from day
one — just a learning mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to ask thoughtful
questions, structure problems clearly, and contribute hands-on to meaningful outcomes.
You'll thrive here if you enjoy working shoulder-to-shoulder in a small, entrepreneurial team
— one where hierarchy takes a back seat, ideas are welcomed regardless of title, and
everyone has the chance to make a visible impact. We move fast, stay realistic, and keep
things straightforward, with no politics slowing us down. We value people who stay
composed amid ambiguity and are excited to help Shohri grow through delivery, proposals,
and knowledge sharing.
FINANCE TRANSFORMATION
Finance Transformation Consultant
Job Description
A recognized leader in digital finance, you bring sharp analytical thinking and a genuine
appetite for complex problem-solving. You see complexity as opportunity. Where others
stall, you move — identifying the root issue, structuring the solution, and driving it through
to impact. Clients trust you because your counsel is sharp, evidence-based, and built for
results.
You design and deliver solutions that lift operational e􀆯iciency, strengthen compliance,
and unlock revenue growth — working alongside your team to solve today's toughest
finance challenges and get ahead of tomorrows.
You will be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and entrepreneurial team where your ideas are
valued and your development is supported. From day one, you will have opportunities to
work with experienced consultants, engage with clients, and contribute to work that
creates measurable outcomes.
Responsibilities
 Support clients in modernizing their finance functions — contributing to strategy
discussions with internal and external stakeholders, and helping structure and
prioritize your team's workflow
 Build strong working relationships with client teams and contribute meaningfully to
senior leadership discussions
 Support both Project Management O􀆯ice (PMO) and Transformation Management
O􀆯ice (TMO) functions — helping clients not only track delivery, but drive the
broader organizational change that makes transformation stick
 Help design strategies and blueprints that apply digital tools, including AI, to
improve operations and refine core processes (procure-to-pay, order-to-cash,
record-to-report, treasury, financial planning & analysis)
 Evaluate Cloud ERP solutions for clients, and help share best practices across
engagements
 Contribute to new business proposals and support practice growth initiatives
 Contribute to business development by supporting proposal materials, credentials,
case studies, and market or client research
 Stay current on regulations, trends, and technologies shaping digital finance,
analytics, and the CFO agenda
Qualifications
 2-6 years of finance, accounting, auditing or management consulting experience
 Experience in Digital Finance and ERP platform implementations: CFO Analytics,
SAP S/4HANA, AI, and/or Robotics Process Automation
 Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration or in a related
field
 CPA is a plus
 Business-level English proficiency
 Japanese speaking is a plus

job.title: MWS Manager
job.description:

About the Role
Accountable for the development and implementation of the Antipolo Factory’s IE/MWS programs in line with the factory’s strategic plans, CBN and long-term strategies and vision. The IE/MWS Manager plays a key role in the deployment of MWS pillars through cross functional teams to achieve factory KPI’s and support the Antipolo factory in achieving world class manufacturing excellence.

Key Responsibilities
Deploys IE Methodologies to increase site cost competitiveness:

  • Develops long term roadmap and master plan for the factory including the capital and equipment plan with support from the Factory Management Team;
  • Conducts scenario planning and modelling to identify site future cost competitive opportunities;
  • Conducts labour planning analysis of long-term capacity and labour balance to ensure effective labour utilisation;
  • Maintain connection with other markets for potential supply opportunities, work with planning and finance BP for capacity and financial deep dive and actions for volume growth.
  • Works closely with VSM and Planning team, identifies opportunities to optimize headcount in the factory while enhance the capacity to support the growth of Asia markets.
  • Regularly review current equipment output rate, update operation parameter to ensure up-to-date TRS, thus optimize equipment operation efficiency for reliable and predictable output.
  • Accountable for ATP VL deliverable, coach and facilitate cross-functional workshops for achievable plans. Actively enroll in regional sustainability and other cost saving projects.
  • CAB (CAPEX) Management on site, shaping, strategy, spend profile, BIDS & IRR Support.

Deploys and leads the MWS programs in the Antipolo factory:

  • Actively participates as part of the Factory Management Team and establishes a IE/MWS master plan for the Antipolo factory;
  • In line with the factory strategies and goals, deploys plans across all the MWS pillars and oversees their timely execution;
  • Builds a MWS culture across the organization through communication, promotion and recognition the MWS pillars, tools and individual success stories;
  • Leads factory FI pillar and ensure deployment of Focused Improvement Teams to conduct detailed loss analysis and ensure the team deployment is consistent and aligned with the major losses and priorities on site;
  • Be the champion for factory performance data in the factory including accuracy, timeliness and consistency of data;
  • Provides mentorship, management, and performance review for MWS activities’ teams; and

  • Track, validate, and present the factory operational results to factory management and Regional.
  • Be the champion for factory performance data in the factory including accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of data.
  • Involve FMT members for engagement and development for all individual MWS team members
  • Understands, identifies and practices Quality and Food Safety Procedures and standards in typical food process plant operation; and
  • Performs other duties as may be assigned by the Plant Director.


Key Requirements

  • BS Degree or Graduate of Mechanical, Electrical, Electronic, Industrial Engineering or any similar course
  • At least 10 years LEAN/TPM experience in a multinational food company with the last 5 years in a managerial capacity; preferably FMCG
  • With experience in working on HACCP/ Food Safety/ GMP
  • With a proven track record as a change leader in the deployment of LEAN / TPM Programs
  • Extensive experience in LEAN/TPM methodologies and should be at an advance or expert level in the core pillars – FI, AM and PM
  • Good knowledge and skills in statistics, and finance analysis
  • Strong communication skill and project management experience

job.title: Corporate Affairs Head
job.description:

This executive-level role will oversee the company's external communications strategy, corporate positioning, media relations, crisis communications, and regulatory-facing messaging within the rapidly evolving iGaming industry. The successful candidate will serve as a key liaison between the organization and relevant government agencies, regulators, media outlets, and industry stakeholders, ensuring consistent messaging, regulatory alignment, and effective reputation management.

This is a full onsite role, with the office located in BGC, Taguig.

Key Job Responsibilities:

  • Government and Regulatory Relations: Serve as the primary liaison with PAGCOR, relevant government agencies, and industry associations, maintaining strong stakeholder relationships and supporting the company's regulatory standing and public policy engagement.
  • Corporate Communications Strategy: Develop and lead the company's external communications strategy, including media relations, executive visibility, corporate positioning, and brand messaging across relevant channels.
  • Crisis and Reputation Management: Establish and implement crisis communications protocols, proactively managing reputational risks arising from regulatory scrutiny, negative media coverage, and public controversies related to the iGaming industry.
  • Media Relations: Build and maintain relationships with journalists, media organizations, and industry publications to support accurate, consistent, and strategic media coverage.
  • Regulatory Communications and Compliance: Collaborate closely with Legal and Compliance teams to ensure public statements, corporate communications, and regulatory-facing materials align with applicable PAGCOR requirements and licensing obligations.
  • Executive Communications: Prepare speeches, public statements, executive briefings, internal communications, and other materials for senior leadership.
  • External Representation: Represent the company at industry events, regulatory consultations, public forums, and other stakeholder engagements as required.
  • Strategic Advisory: Advise senior leadership on reputational risks, emerging public policy developments, regulatory changes, and external issues affecting the Philippine iGaming sector.
  • Function Development: Build and strengthen the Corporate Affairs and Communications function, including establishing processes, defining team structures, and managing external partners such as PR agencies and media monitoring providers.

Key job qualifications include:

  • 10–12 years of experience in corporate affairs, public relations, government relations, corporate communications, or a related field, with at least five years in a senior leadership role.
  • Demonstrated experience working within regulated or highly scrutinized industries, such as gaming, financial services, telecommunications, or related sectors.
  • Established relationships with, or a proven ability to engage effectively with, Philippine regulatory agencies, government stakeholders, and industry associations.
  • Proven track record in crisis communications, reputation management, and navigating sensitive public or regulatory issues under pressure.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Filipino, with the ability to develop messaging for executive, regulatory, media, and public audiences.
  • Strong media relations expertise, including experience developing media networks, managing press engagement, and proactively shaping corporate narratives.
  • Strong strategic judgment, stakeholder management, and executive advisory capabilities.
  • A hands-on leadership approach, with the ability to establish functions, develop processes, and manage external agencies while building longer-term organizational capabilities.

job.title: Clinical Research Associate II
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm's Healthcare Division is partnering with a world leading organisation in the Biotechnology industry to hire a Clinical Research Associate II to be based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

As a Clinical Research Associate II, you'll conduct remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manage required documentation. You will manage procedures and guidelines from different sponsors and/or monitoring environments (i.e., FSO, FSP, Government, etc.). Acting as a site processes specialist, you will ensure that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, and SOPs to guarantee subjects' rights, well-being, and data reliability. You will ensure audit readiness and develop collaborative relationships with investigational sites. Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to your role are outlined in the task matrix.

Job Responsibilities:
• Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks. Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards. Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner. Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan. Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings
• resolution. Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable.
• Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. May help to identify potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
• Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
• Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the team as required. Ensures study systems are complete, accurate and updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
• Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and internal project teams through written, oral and/or electronic contacts. Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
• Maintains and completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
• Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Job Requirements:
Education and Experience Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in a life sciences related field or a Registered Nursing certification or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification.
• Minimal clinical monitoring experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 2 years) in a clinical environment where experience is gained in clinical trials, medical terminology, medical research, clinical research or health care or experience in a health sciences field with formal training in medical terminology and anatomy may be considered.
• Valid driver's license where applicable.
In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Basic medical/therapeutic area knowledge and understanding of medical terminology
• Ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCPs and applicable regulations and procedural documents
• Good oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
• Good interpersonal skills
• Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
• Good organizational and time management skills
• Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
• Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
• Ability to manage Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
• Ability to work in a team or independently as required
• Good computer skills: solid knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software
• Good English language and grammar skills

Working Conditions and Environment:
• Work is performed in an office/clinical/and/or home office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
• Frequent drives to site locations. Frequent travel, generally 60-80% but more for some individuals. May also include extended overnight stays.
• Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
• Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

job.title: Regional Product Support Engineer - Network and Systems
job.description:
Regional Product Support Engineer - Network and Systems

Introduction
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Regional Product Support Engineer – Farm Management & Network. This opportunity is based in Klang, Malaysia.

Position Overview
This role is responsible for providing advanced, escalation-level technical support across farm management and network systems, ensuring reliable deployment, compliance, and continuous improvement of engineering solutions. It plays a critical part in strengthening regional technical standards and driving product reliability across country operations.

Key Responsibilities

Advanced Technical Support (Escalation-Level)

  • Resolve complex hardware, software, connectivity, and system-level issues escalated by country Service teams.
  • Troubleshoot advanced farm network setups (LAN, Wi-Fi, gateways, routers, long range links, interference).
  • Lead root cause investigations and coordinate corrective actions with Global/Asia Engineering and suppliers.
  • Support key deployments, pilots, and go-live validation when engineering-level expertise is required.

System Deployment & Engineering Quality

  • Ensure new systems are installed, configured, and commissioned according to engineering requirements.
  • Validate installations performed by country Service teams and correct technical gaps where needed.
  • Ensure stable, secure communication between on-farm devices, gateways, and cloud platforms.
  • Oversee system testing, performance verification, and technical acceptance at critical sites.

Regional Standards & Compliance

  • Develop and maintain regional standards for installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, and network design.
  • Train and guide country Service teams to ensure consistent implementation of standards.
  • Conduct technical audits and reviews to verify compliance and identify areas for improvement.
  • Maintain engineering documentation, procedures, checklists, and training materials.

Solution Design & Sales Engineering Support

  • Support Sales and quotation teams with technical feasibility assessments and solution design, especially for non-standard or custom configurations.
  • Recommend system architectures, network designs, and equipment configurations tailored to unique farm layouts or operational needs.
  • Ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, deployable, and aligned with long-term system reliability.
  • Clarify technical assumptions and engineering scope for Sales during pre-sales and proposal development.

Product Improvement & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Gather structured feedback from farmers, country Service teams, and Sales to identify product issues or enhancement opportunities.
  • Participate in testing and validating new firmware, software, or hardware updates before regional rollout.
  • Share recurring issues and regional technical insights with Global/Asia Engineering and suppliers.
  • Facilitate cross-country knowledge transfer and best practice sharing.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, IT, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
  • 3+ years of experience in technical support, system integration, or product engineering roles.
  • Experience with agricultural technology, industrial automation, or IoT systems preferred.
  • Regional or multi-country support experience is an advantage.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong expertise in troubleshooting complex hardware–software systems and IoT devices.
  • Proficiency in farm network infrastructure, including LAN, Wi-Fi, routers, switches, gateways, and connectivity optimisation.
  • Ability to design and validate network architecture for large or challenging farm environments.
  • Hands-on experience with sensors, controllers, gateways, and farm management platforms.
  • Understanding of cloud-based systems, data communication, and device-to-cloud integrations.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Willingness to travel to farms and country offices for support, audits, and training.
  • Ability to work in challenging field environments and adapt solutions to real farm conditions.
  • Carry out any other duties as and when instructed by Management.

job.title: Senior Financial Controller
job.description:
Job Title: Senior Financial Controller
Job Location: Ayutthaya
Industry: International Manufacturing Company


Job Summary:
The Senior Financial Controller will lead the group’s financial operations and reporting of the manufacturing sites. This role oversees multi-site accounting teams, ensures strict compliance with international financial standards, and manages cross-border cash flows, tax planning, and internal controls.

Global Financial Reporting & Compliance

  • Direct the preparation of accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual consolidated financial statements under USGAAP, THAI GAAP, IFRS, and SOX Compliance.
  • Oversee multi-currency accounting operations across various international subsidiaries.
  • Ensure full compliance with local and international tax laws, transfer pricing regulations, and statutory reporting requirements.
  • Manage annual global external audits and coordinate with external tax advisors and regulatory bodies.

Manufacturing Finance & Cost Control

  • Monitor global manufacturing costs, standard costing models, bill of materials (BOM), and variance analyses.
  • Track inventory valuations, supply chain costs, and capital expenditures across international production plants.
  • Implement continuous cost-saving initiatives and operational efficiency improvements.

Compliance & Governance

  • Manage compliance with Thailand's Board of Investment (BOI) privileges, customs duties, and transfer pricing regulations.
  • Strengthen internal control frameworks and corporate governance procedures.
  • Act as the primary liaison for external auditors, tax advisors, and regulatory agencies.

Treasury & Cash Management

  • Oversee global cash flow forecasting, liquidity management, and foreign exchange (FX) risk mitigation.
  • Manage banking relationships across multiple jurisdictions and optimize working capital.

Internal Controls & Risk Management

  • Strengthen and enforce robust internal financial controls across all international business units.
  • Identify financial risks and implement corrective action plans.
  • Supervise the integration of financial systems for newly acquired entities or expanding facilities.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a distributed team of regional financial controllers and accountants.
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration with operations, supply chain, and executive leadership.


Job Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance.
  • License: Thai CPD (Certified Public Accountant / Continuing Professional Development) license is required.
  • Experience: Minimum 10–12 years of finance experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role within a manufacturing environment.
  • Technical Skills: Strong knowledge of Accounting standards like IFRS, USGAAP, THAI GAAP, SOX Compliance, BOI rules, Thai tax laws, and ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Infor System).
  • Language: Excellent written and spoken English communication skills.

job.title: Technical Engineer
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Technical Engineer. This opportunity is based in Penang, Malaysia.

Position Overview

The Technical Engineer will provide customer-facing technical and application support across Malaysia, Thailand and Singapore, converting customer requirements into technically qualified opportunities. The role serves as a key link between customers, the regional commercial team and R&D, directly shaping product recommendations and supporting the organisation's technical growth in the region.

Key Responsibilities

Customer Technical & Application Support

  • Conduct customer technical discovery through meetings, technical visits, process reviews, CTQ collection, application requirement mapping and issue clarification.
  • Understand customer processes and translate application requirements into suitable product recommendations and technical next steps.
  • Support Sales and Business Development on qualified opportunities through technical discussions, product selection and customer evaluations.
  • Provide technical support during customer trials, first-use manufacturing and product qualification activities.
  • Build effective working relationships with customer engineering, process, quality and technical teams.

Application Testing & Qualification

  • Coordinate sample requests, trial preparation and customer evaluation follow-up.
  • Conduct or coordinate application screening activities including sample preparation, handling observations, cure evaluation, adhesion checks, pot life/work life assessment and process compatibility review.
  • Summarise trial results, observations, risks and recommended next actions in a clear and structured manner.
  • Coordinate with the Technical Manager, QC, R&D or Lab for advanced testing, failure analysis, formulation questions, reliability requirements or special customer requests.
  • Maintain proper test records, sample traceability and technical documentation in accordance with ISO 9001 and internal quality procedures.

Technical Project Management

  • Track strategic and qualified technical projects including customer requirements, project stage, technical barriers, next milestones and support required.
  • Ensure timely follow-up from initial inquiry through recommendation, sample evaluation, qualification and first commercial use.
  • Work closely with Sales and Business Development to improve sample-to-trial and trial-to-first-purchase conversion.
  • Provide structured project updates and highlight technical risks or resource requirements to the Technical Manager.

R&D & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Maintain regular communication with the Technical Manager and R&D team on customer findings, application trends, technical gaps and emerging technology requirements.
  • Share Voice of Customer (VOC) and market/application insights that may support product development and application roadmap planning.
  • Work closely with QC on product quality questions, specifications, COA matters, complaint information and abnormal test findings.
  • Coordinate with Operations and Supply Chain on sample availability, packaging, lead time, handling requirements and trial readiness.
  • Collaborate with Marketing on technically accurate application materials, case studies, technical tips, seminar presentations and application diagrams when required.

Technical Knowledge & Market Development

  • Develop clear technical reports, application notes, case summaries, diagrams and internal knowledge records.
  • Support technical seminars, customer presentations and regional technical sharing activities.
  • Develop understanding of emerging applications and technologies in areas such as semiconductor packaging, electronic assembly, optoelectronics, CPO/NPO, thermal management and related electronics applications.
  • Gather customer and market technical information and communicate relevant findings internally.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Polymer Science, Material Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline is preferred.
  • Candidates with Mechanical or Electronics Engineering backgrounds may also be considered with relevant materials, process or application experience.
  • 1–3 years of experience in technical service, application engineering, process engineering, adhesives, coatings, electronic materials, semiconductor or industrial materials is preferred.
  • Fresh graduates with a strong polymer, chemistry or material science background may be considered if they demonstrate strong learning ability, hands-on discipline and communication maturity.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Ability to understand customer application requirements and translate them into practical product recommendations, screening plans and trial actions.
  • Ability to distinguish between confirmed data, assumptions, technical risks and recommended next steps.
  • Competent in Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint for technical reports, data summaries and presentations.
  • Experience with epoxy, silicone or other adhesive/material applications would be advantageous.
  • Hands-on laboratory or manufacturing process experience involving sample preparation, material testing, data recording, failure observation or customer trial support would be advantageous.
  • Knowledge or experience in semiconductor packaging, electronic assembly, optoelectronics, thermal management or related electronics applications would be an advantage.
  • Willing to travel within Southeast Asia for customer visits, line trials, seminars and technical support activities.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with a hands-on technical mindset.
  • Strong ownership and disciplined project follow-up.
  • Good communication and presentation skills with the ability to interact effectively with customers and internal teams.
  • Self-motivated, open-minded and willing to learn new technologies and applications.
  • Ability to work independently while knowing when technical escalation is required.
  • Strong teamwork and cross-functional collaboration with Sales, BD, QC, R&D, Marketing and Operations.
  • Good command of English, with additional Southeast Asian language capability considered an advantage.

job.title: Managing Director Indonesia
job.description:
Managing Director – Indonesia

Location: South Jakarta, Indonesia
Industry: FMCG
Level: Executive
Employment Type: Full-time

About the Opportunity

Monroe is representing a European FMCG company with an established presence in Indonesia and a strong track record of business performance.

We are seeking an experienced Commercial Leader to lead the overall business and organization, with responsibility for driving sustainable growth, strengthening commercial execution, and developing a high-performing leadership team.

This is a highly visible leadership role, working closely with regional stakeholders and leading the Indonesia business across key commercial and corporate functions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the overall Indonesia business, with accountability for commercial performance, organizational development, and business growth.
  • Own and manage the P&L, driving both topline growth and bottom-line performance.
  • Develop and execute the Indonesia business strategy in alignment with regional and global objectives.
  • Drive Sales and Marketing effectiveness, ensuring strong alignment between brand strategy, commercial priorities, and market execution.
  • Lead the development and execution of go-to-market strategies across relevant channels and customer segments.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen market presence, accelerate growth, and improve business performance.
  • Lead, motivate, challenge, and develop the leadership team to deliver against ambitious business objectives.
  • Foster a collaborative and high-performing organizational culture while maintaining strong employee engagement.
  • Work closely with regional and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, share best practices, and support broader business initiatives.
  • Ensure effective collaboration across functions including Sales, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Commercial Excellence, and other relevant areas.
  • Represent the Indonesia business at senior regional and organizational forums.
  • Provide clear strategic direction while maintaining strong execution discipline across the organization.

Key Requirements

  • 15+ years of relevant FMCG experience, with significant exposure to the Indonesian market.
  • Proven experience in a senior commercial leadership or general management position.
  • Strong leadership experience spanning both Sales and Marketing. Candidates with experience exclusively in one commercial function may not be suitable.
  • Demonstrated P&L management experience, with ownership of both topline and bottom-line results.
  • Strong understanding of the Indonesian consumer, retail, and go-to-market landscape.
  • Proven track record of driving business growth and leading organizational transformation or significant business initiatives.
  • Strong ability to translate strategy into commercial execution and measurable business results.
  • Experience managing and developing senior leadership teams.
  • Strong regional and cross-functional stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Excellent strategic, commercial, and decision-making skills.
  • Mature, collaborative, and people-oriented leadership style.
  • Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a regional environment.

Leadership Profile

The successful candidate will combine strong commercial leadership with a genuine people-development mindset.

We are looking for a leader who can set high expectations while remaining approachable, collaborative, and supportive of the organization. The ability to balance people, performance, and long-term business development will be important.

The ideal candidate will bring the maturity to make sound business decisions, challenge the organization constructively, and build strong relationships across functions and geographies.

job.title: UX Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Information Technology sector to hire a UX Manager. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

Lead the UX function and drive user-centred design practices across digital products, ensuring exceptional user experiences and design excellence.

Oversee the evolution and governance of the organisation's Design System to deliver consistency, scalability, accessibility, and efficiency across platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and mentor UX designers, fostering a high-performance and collaborative design culture.
  • Manage UX resources, priorities, and project delivery across multiple initiatives.
  • Oversee UX projects from discovery, research, wireframing, prototyping, testing, and validation through delivery.
  • Ensure design quality, accessibility, implementation consistency, and adherence to UX and Design System standards across products.
  • Drive user research, usability testing, and data-informed design improvements.
  • Partner with Product Managers, Developers, QA teams, and business stakeholders to prioritise and deliver customer-focused solutions.
  • Own and govern the Design System, including standards, components, design tokens, accessibility, documentation, and adoption.
  • Define and manage the Design System roadmap to improve scalability, efficiency, and cross-platform consistency.
  • Establish governance, review, and quality assurance processes for UX and Design System adoption across products.
  • Define UX standards and acceptance criteria for accessibility, responsive behaviour, content handling, and Design System implementation quality.
  • Lead design reviews and facilitate alignment across UX, business, product, technology, and stakeholder groups.

job.title: Senior Manager, Merchandising & Product Sourcing
job.description:
Executive Recruitment Consultant Monroe Consulting Group is working with a leading international home improvement and general merchandise retailer, with an established presence in Indonesia and a broad product assortment covering home improvement, household, lifestyle, hardware, and general merchandise products.

As part of its continued business growth, the company is looking to appoint a Senior Manager Merchandising & Product Sourcing to lead strategic product sourcing, product development, and assortment development for the Indonesian market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead strategic product sourcing and product development initiatives based on Indonesian consumer needs, market trends, and business opportunities.
  • Identify assortment gaps, emerging trends, new product opportunities, and potential categories relevant to the Indonesian market.
  • Translate consumer and market insights into commercially viable product and assortment recommendations.
  • Manage the end-to-end product development process, from product ideation and sourcing through supplier engagement, evaluation, and commercialization.
  • Work closely with international sourcing teams and suppliers/manufacturers in China to identify and develop relevant products for the Indonesian market.
  • Identify, evaluate, and develop relationships with strategic suppliers and manufacturers.
  • Collaborate with suppliers on product specifications, quality, costing, pricing, lead time, and product development requirements.
  • Conduct market, competitor, and category analysis to ensure the assortment remains relevant, differentiated, and commercially competitive.
  • Evaluate product opportunities based on consumer relevance, sales potential, pricing, margin, and overall category strategy.
  • Partner with the local merchandising team to translate product sourcing opportunities into the appropriate local assortment and category strategy.
  • Drive category and assortment development initiatives to improve product productivity, differentiation, competitiveness, and commercial performance.
  • Lead negotiations with suppliers and business partners to achieve optimal commercial terms.
  • Manage and influence stakeholders across local commercial teams, international teams, sourcing offices, and external suppliers.
  • Present product, sourcing, category, and assortment recommendations to senior management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Merchandising, Supply Chain, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in product sourcing, product development, merchandising, buying, category development, or related functions.
  • Strong track record in product sourcing, product development, and supplier/vendor management.
  • Experience in home improvement, household, hardware, hardgoods, general merchandise, lifestyle, or consumer products is highly preferred.
  • Experience working within an international buying office, global sourcing organization, multinational retailer, or consumer product business is highly advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of consumer trends, market insights, assortment development, and commercial evaluation.
  • Proven experience managing suppliers/manufacturers, particularly those based in China or other international sourcing markets.
  • Strong commercial acumen with an understanding of costing, pricing, margin, and product profitability.
  • Excellent negotiation, analytical, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • Mandarin proficiency is highly preferred.
  • Comfortable working independently and driving initiatives in a newly established role.
  • Willingness to travel internationally when required.

job.title: Chief Business Development and Performance
job.description:
Our client, a diversified and growing business group, is looking for a Chief Business Development & Performance to work closely with the CEO in evaluating, developing, and executing new business ventures across multiple industries.

This is a highly strategic yet hands-on role for someone who can turn business ideas into viable projects, assess their commercial potential, and drive them from concept through execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Work closely with the CEO to identify and evaluate new business opportunities and ventures.
  • Conduct business feasibility studies, financial calculations, projections, and ROI assessments.
  • Develop business cases and provide data-driven recommendations to support investment and business decisions.
  • Assess opportunities across a broad range of industries and business models, including but not limited to mining, hospitality, F&B, media, and other emerging sectors.
  • Lead and manage projects from initial concept, feasibility assessment, and planning through execution.
  • Monitor project and business performance against targets, budgets, and timelines.
  • Identify commercial opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure successful project implementation.
  • Act as a strategic partner to the CEO, providing commercial insights and recommendations for new ventures.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in business development, strategy, consulting, corporate development, investment, or project management.
  • Candidates with a management/strategy consulting background are highly preferred.
  • Strong experience in business analysis, financial modelling, feasibility studies, and project evaluation.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage projects from concept to execution.
  • Comfortable working across multiple industries and unfamiliar business models.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and commercial skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present recommendations to C-level executives.
  • Entrepreneurial, adaptable, and comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

job.title: Senior Operations Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Logistics sector to hire a Senior Operations Manager. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.

Position Overview
The role leads and manages the 4PL Hub Operations Team to deliver high-quality logistics services. It plays a critical role in ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and continuous improvement across regional supply chain operations.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing operations team within the assigned 4PL Hub Operations Team.
  • Build and nurture a high-performing team culture that emphasises accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Empower team members by delegating responsibilities effectively, encouraging innovation, and recognising contributions.
  • Act as a role model for ethical leadership, promoting transparency, integrity, and compliance across all operations.
  • Develop succession planning and talent pipelines to ensure long-term organisational resilience.
  • Define team structure, roles, and responsibilities aligned with business goals and customer expectations.
  • Lead change management initiatives, guiding teams through organisational restructuring, digital transformation, and evolving customer demands.
  • Mentor and coach managers and team leaders, equipping them with the skills and confidence to manage complex logistics operations.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
  • Manage escalations, performance issues, and ensure adequate coverage during holidays or absences.
  • Drive employee engagement and retention through coaching, recognition, and career development planning.
  • Operational Oversight & Execution
  • Oversee end-to-end logistics operations including planning, booking, and shipment monitoring to ensure seamless execution.
  • Ensure compliance with customer contracts, service level agreements (SLAs), and key performance indicators (KPIs).
  • Implement and enforce standardised processes across the team to ensure consistency and efficiency.
  • Monitor daily dashboards and proactively address deviations or bottlenecks in real-time.
  • Develop and implement strategies to optimise supply chain efficiency and resilience.
