job.title: Service & Sales Engineer (Mechanical & Electrical)
job.description:
Service & Sales Engineer (Mechanical & Electrical)

Introduction
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a well-established organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Service & Sales Engineer (Mechanical & Electrical). This opportunity is based in Selangor, Malaysia.
Position Overview
This role is responsible for delivering technical service, installation, and maintenance support for mechanical and electrical equipment systems at customer farm sites, while identifying opportunities for spare parts and service sales. It plays a key part in ensuring equipment reliability, customer satisfaction, and long-term account growth for the organisation.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Service & Support (Mechanical & Electrical)
  • Perform installation, testing, service, and commissioning of BD equipment systems.
  • Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve mechanical and electrical faults at the farm sites.
  • Conduct electrical fault finding and troubleshooting for control circuits, sensors, actuators, motors, and power systems.
  • Inspect wiring, grounding, and power distribution to identify and rectify hazards or inefficiencies.
  • Carry out loop checks, insulation resistance testing, and continuity testing
  • Conduct preventive and corrective maintenance to ensure equipment reliability and compliance with safety standards.
  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of system technologies and provide technical guidance to customers.
  • Maintain accurate service reports, checklist and maintenance history for each customer
Collaborative Problem Solving
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Product, and Tech teams to anticipate and resolve complex customer challenges before they escalate
Spare Parts Sales & Maintenance
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities via service visits and promote relevant spare parts, upgrades, or service maintenance contracts.
  • Provide technical advice and sales support in upselling of sub-system, promote appropriate solutions for farm maintenance and propose cost-effective replacements or upgrades based on diagnostic reports and lifecycle data
Project & Site Coordination
  • Work closely with project engineers, site supervisors, and contractors during installation and deployment phases.
  • Ensure project timelines are met, and installation quality standards are upheld.
  • Manage changes and variation orders in technical specifications
Customer Training and Support
  • Conduct on-site training for farm operators on equipment use, safety, and maintenance.
  • Prepare and submit service reports, checklists, and feedback after each visit.
  • Provide recommendations to improve system performance and farm efficiency to the customer.
  • Support onboarding and usability: Ensure farmers are onboarded effectively understanding BD systems (from trainings) and anticipating any potential challenges and addressing them before they arise
  • Anticipate Customer Needs: Regularly check in with farmers to proactively identify issues, suggest improvements, and ensure the technology is delivering optimal value.
  • Feedback Loop & Product Advocacy: Actively gather customer feedback to anticipate future needs and inform product development, ensuring the solution evolves to meet farmers' changing challenges.
Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience
  • Degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Automation Engineering.
  • Minimum 2–5 years' experience in field service, technical sales, or equipment installation, preferably in agriculture or livestock equipment.
Technical / Functional Expertise
  • Hands-on knowledge in mechanical assemblies and electrical control panels.
  • Strong knowledge of Programmable Logic Controllers (PLCs), Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), and network communication protocols (e.g., LAN, IP configuration).
  • Experience in automation systems and industrial networking will be an added advantage.
  • Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering and wiring diagrams.
  • Familiarity with poultry farming operations is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in MS Office.
Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies
  • Customer service mindset with good interpersonal communication.
  • Willingness to travel (domestic & overseas) to farm or project sites as per project duration.
  • Willingness to work on weekends and public holidays as per project duration.

job.title: Regional Treasury Manager (Regional Treasurer)
job.description:
Position Overview
The Regional Treasury Manager will take full ownership of regional cash management, liquidity optimization, banking operations, and treasury governance across multiple entities in the region. The role will be responsible for driving efficient cash utilization, managing cross-border cash flows, supporting banking relationships, and ensuring compliance with treasury policies and local regulations.
Key Responsibilities

  • Lead regional cash forecasting, liquidity planning, and cash flow optimization across multiple countries.
  • Execute and streamline intercompany funding, dividend repatriation, and cross-border cash movements while minimizing FX exposure and transactional costs.
  • Manage and optimize cash pooling and Zero Balance Account (ZBA) structures across the region.
  • Oversee banking operations, including bank account administration, KYC requirements, signatory management, and banking relationship management.
  • Negotiate banking fees, FX spreads, and treasury-related service costs.
  • Deliver accurate treasury, liquidity, and cash reporting to senior leadership, including the Regional CFO and Group Treasurer.
  • Ensure compliance with treasury policies, local banking regulations, capital controls, transfer pricing requirements, and other regulatory obligations.
  • Partner closely with Finance, Tax, Controlling, and business stakeholders to support funding requirements and strategic initiatives.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • 7-10 years of corporate treasury experience within an MNC or regional headquarters environment.
  • Strong expertise in cash management, liquidity planning, banking operations, and treasury controls.
  • Experience managing multi-country treasury activities, intercompany funding, and cross-border transactions.
  • Good knowledge of Treasury Management Systems (TMS), ERP platforms such as SAP or Oracle, and electronic banking portals.
  • Solid understanding of regional banking regulations, capital controls, transfer pricing considerations, and withholding tax implications.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to operate independently in a highly visible regional role.

job.title: Story Specialist
job.description:
Who We Are

International Justice Mission (IJM) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable.

We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve.

The Need

For 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence by 2030, we are seeking a Survivor Leadership Specialist to provide strategic direction and implement the growth of national survivor networks—ensuring alignment with IJM’s Protection Model and the Global Survivor Network (GSN). The role will also engage with government agencies, NGOs, and survivor-led movements to increase victim protection, expand safe and ethical survivor participation, and build safe reporting channels and inclusive platforms for advocacy

This position is based in Bangkok, Thailand and reports to Social Services Manager and is only available for candidates with the right to work in Thailand. Candidates should be based in Thailand and proficient in English and Thai.

Responsibilities


  1. Development, implementation, and continuous improvement of survivor leadership and survivor network strategies, ensuring programs are trauma-informed, aligned with IJM Global standards, and responsive to IJM’s project goals and Protection Model;

  1. Provide technical leadership and support to emerging and existing survivor networks, including identification and development of survivor leaders, and the creation of safe, inclusive physical and virtual spaces for survivors to organize, advocate, and lead initiatives;

  1. Design and delivery of capacity development (training, coaching, mentoring and support) for survivor network members, enabling survivor leaders to engage effectively in advocacy and provide survivor-informed recommendations, including through trauma-informed practice, ethical storytelling, and survivor-led advocacy;

Strategy & Program Implementation


  1. Mentor and equip survivor leaders to engage as credible, ethical, and effective voices in advocating for protection;

  1. Lead the design and implementation of survivor leadership strategies that strengthen local survivor networks and build advocacy capacity related to forced labor, labor trafficking, and labor exploitation;

  1. Ensure trauma-informed and participatory approaches in program design and implementation;

  1. Conduct risk assessments and oversee and safeguarding measures to ensure survivor safety in advocacy, media, and public engagement;

  1. Empower survivors to initiate and implement survivor leadership initiatives that contribute to protection, prevention and systems change;

  1. Provide or coordinate coaching and mentoring support to survivor network members.

Survivor Networking & Advocate Development


  1. Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to provide technical support for survivor network growth and sustainability;

  1. Identify and support survivor leaders, ensuring inclusive representation across gender, nationality, exploitation type, and geography, expanding group members to scale impact;

  1. Conduct survivor network capacity development training;

  1. Facilitate safe meeting spaces and structured pathways for survivor-led initiatives and advocacy;

  1. Co-develop virtual survivor networks, particularly in newer forms of exploitation such as forced scamming;

  1. Support survivor networks to implement community‑level protection and awareness activities, contributing to increased reliance and protection.

Communication


  1. Provide survivor‑informed input into advocacy messaging, ethical storytelling, and communications that contribute to policy improvement, increased victim protection, and justice system performance.

Training and Capacity Development


  1. Ensure timely delivery of survivor leadership training, including public speaking, advocacy, and media engagement.

  1. Identify and coordinate capacity‑building resources to support survivor leaders’ advocacy and engagement.

  1. Ensure survivor leaders have access to psychosocial support, stress management, and well‑being resources.

  1. Develop or adapt training tools on trauma‑informed practice, survivor‑led advocacy, safeguarding, and ethical public engagement.

Research, Program Management and M&E


  1. Work with Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL) staff to integrate survivor consultation and leadership into monitoring, evaluation, research and learning;

  1. Support research and learning initiatives related to survivor leadership, advocacy, and participation

Documentation, Reporting & Data Management


  1. Maintain survivor network tracking, monitor participation and growth, and document learning and best practices;

  1. Ensure the documentation of key training activities and advocacy initiatives;

  1. Develop, monitor, and manage survivor leadership budget and expenses in coordination with department leadership.

Qualifications:


  • Master's degree in social work preferred, or Bachelors’ degree with equivalent professional experience;

  • Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in survivor services, social work, human rights, or related NGO/CSO contexts;

  • Demonstrated experience supporting survivor leadership, networks, or movements;

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience coaching and mentoring;

  • Experience in coaching, mentoring, or facilitating adult learning, preferably with survivors or community leaders;

  • Understanding of government systems and processes related to forced labor, human trafficking, and labor exploitation;

  • Demonstrated experience supporting formation and development of networks of survivors or similar groups;

  • Demonstrated expertise in assessing and developing capacity of professionals in trauma-informed approaches or other relevant skills.

Critical Qualities:


  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills;

  • Excellent planning and implementing skills;

  • Deep familiarity with trauma‑informed and survivor‑centered approaches;

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills;

  • Fluency in oral and written English and Thai;

  • Leadership in mentoring, coaching, consulting, and training skills;

  • International/cross-cultural experience in development, relief, social work, or other fields;

  • Relationship‑building and networking;

  • Facilitation and coordination;

  • Sound judgment and ethical decision making;

  • Effective team player;

  • Humble, service-oriented attitude;

  • Highest integrity and honesty;

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information;

  • Strong interpersonal skills;

  • Professional, diplomatic, and mature demeanor.

International Justice Mission (IJM) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable. 

 

We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve.   

 

 

The Need 

For 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence by 2030, we are seeking a Survivor Leadership Specialist to provide strategic direction and implement the growth of national survivor networks—ensuring alignment with IJM’s Protection Model and the Global Survivor Network (GSN). The role will also engage with government agencies, NGOs, and survivor-led movements to increase victim protection, expand safe and ethical survivor participation, and build safe reporting channels and inclusive platforms for advocacy 

 

 

This position is based in Bangkok, Thailand and reports to Social Services Manager and is only available for candidates with the right to work in Thailand. Candidates should be based in Thailand and proficient in English and Thai. 

 

 

Responsibilities 

 

  1. Development, implementation, and continuous improvement of survivor leadership and survivor network strategies, ensuring programs are trauma-informed, aligned with IJM Global standards, and responsive to IJM’s project goals and Protection Model; 

  1. Provide technical leadership and support to emerging and existing survivor networks, including identification and development of survivor leaders, and the creation of safe, inclusive physical and virtual spaces for survivors to organize, advocate, and lead initiatives; 

  1. Design and delivery of capacity development (training, coaching, mentoring and support) for survivor network members, enabling survivor leaders to engage effectively in advocacy and provide survivor-informed recommendations, including through trauma-informed practice, ethical storytelling, and survivor-led advocacy; 

 

 

Strategy & Program Implementation   

  1. Mentor and equip survivor leaders to engage as credible, ethical, and effective voices in advocating for protection; 

  1. Lead the design and implementation of survivor leadership strategies that strengthen local survivor networks and build advocacy capacity related to forced labor, labor trafficking, and labor exploitation; 

  1. Ensure trauma-informed and participatory approaches in program design and implementation; 

  1. Conduct risk assessments and oversee and safeguarding measures to ensure survivor safety in advocacy, media, and public engagement;  

  1. Empower survivors to initiate and implement survivor leadership initiatives that contribute to protection, prevention and systems change; 

  1. Provide or coordinate coaching and mentoring support to survivor network members.  

 

  

Survivor Networking & Advocate Development 

  1. Collaborate with internal teams and external stakeholders to provide technical support for survivor network growth and sustainability; 

  1. Identify and support survivor leaders, ensuring inclusive representation across gender, nationality, exploitation type, and geography, expanding group members to scale impact; 

  1. Conduct survivor network capacity development training;   

  1. Facilitate safe meeting spaces and structured pathways for survivor-led initiatives and advocacy;  

  1. Co-develop virtual survivor networks, particularly in newer forms of exploitation such as forced scamming;   

  1. Support survivor networks to implement community‑level protection and awareness activities, contributing to increased reliance and protection.  

  

Communication 

  1. Provide survivor‑informed input into advocacy messaging, ethical storytelling, and communications that contribute to policy improvement, increased victim protection, and justice system performance.  

  

Training and Capacity Development 

  1. Ensure timely delivery of survivor leadership training, including public speaking, advocacy, and media engagement.   

  1. Identify and coordinate capacity‑building resources to support survivor leaders’ advocacy and engagement.  

  1. Ensure survivor leaders have access to psychosocial support, stress management, and well‑being resources.   

  1. Develop or adapt training tools on trauma‑informed practice, survivor‑led advocacy, safeguarding, and ethical public engagement.   

  

Research, Program Management and M&E 

  1. Work with Monitoring, Evaluation, Research and Learning (MERL) staff to integrate survivor consultation and leadership into monitoring, evaluation, research and learning; 

  1. Support research and learning initiatives related to survivor leadership, advocacy, and participation  

 

Documentation, Reporting & Data Management  

  1. Maintain survivor network tracking, monitor participation and growth, and document learning and best practices; 

  1. Ensure the documentation of key training activities and advocacy initiatives; 

  1. Develop, monitor, and manage survivor leadership budget and expenses in coordination with department leadership.  

  

 

Qualifications:  

  • Master's degree in social work preferred, or Bachelors’ degree with equivalent professional experience; 

  • Minimum 3–5 years’ experience in survivor services, social work, human rights, or related NGO/CSO contexts; 

  • Demonstrated experience supporting survivor leadership, networks, or movements; 

  • Minimum of 2 years’ experience coaching and mentoring; 

  • Experience in coaching, mentoring, or facilitating adult learning, preferably with survivors or community leaders; 

  • Understanding of government systems and processes related to forced labor, human trafficking, and labor exploitation; 

  • Demonstrated experience supporting formation and development of networks of survivors or similar groups; 

  • Demonstrated expertise in assessing and developing capacity of professionals in trauma-informed approaches or other relevant skills.  

  

Critical Qualities:   

  • Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills;  

  • Excellent planning and implementing skills; 

  • Deep familiarity with trauma‑informed and survivor‑centered approaches; 

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills;  

  • Fluency in oral and written English and Thai; 

  • Leadership in mentoring, coaching, consulting, and training skills;  

  • International/cross-cultural experience in development, relief, social work, or other fields; 

  • Relationship‑building and networking; 

  • Facilitation and coordination; 

  • Sound judgment and ethical decision making; 

  • Effective team player; 

  • Humble, service-oriented attitude; 

  • Highest integrity and honesty; 

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality of sensitive information; 

  • Strong interpersonal skills; 

  • Professional, diplomatic, and mature demeanor.

job.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
job.description:
Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Finance & Financial Planning

  • Develop and lead the organization's financial strategy to support long-term business growth.
  • Prepare medium- and long-term business and financial plans for the company and its subsidiaries.
  • Manage the company's capital structure, fundraising activities, and investment strategies.
  • Serve as a strategic business partner to the CEO and Board of Directors on investment decisions, business expansion, and corporate strategy.

Accounting, Finance & Financial Reporting

  • Oversee all accounting and finance functions for the company and its subsidiaries.
  • Ensure accurate preparation of financial statements in compliance with Thai Financial Reporting Standards (TFRS), and timely submission of quarterly and annual financial reports to the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC).
  • Lead budgeting, financial forecasting, performance analysis, and preparation of the Management Discussion and Analysis (MD&A).
  • Contribute to the preparation of the Annual Registration Statement/Annual Report (Form 56-1 One Report) relating to financial information.
  • Drive management accounting and financial analysis to support executive decision-making.
  • Continuously improve finance and accounting information systems to ensure timely, accurate, and actionable financial data.

Treasury & Liquidity Management

  • Manage cash flow, liquidity, banking facilities, and debt obligations across the company and its subsidiaries.
  • Develop cash flow plans to support both operational requirements and investment activities.

Internal Control, Risk Management & Corporate Governance

  • Develop and strengthen internal control systems, enterprise risk management, and corporate governance practices in accordance with listed company standards.
  • Regularly assess and manage financial risks across the group.
  • Oversee quarterly reviews, statutory audits, and coordinate with the Audit Committee, Internal Audit, and external auditors.
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations, including the Securities and Exchange Act, Public Limited Companies Act, SEC regulations, and SET requirements.
  • Oversee accurate, complete, and timely disclosure of information to the SET, including insider trading controls and blackout period compliance.
  • Perform duties as a designated executive under SEC regulations, including securities holding reports (Form 59) as required.

Stakeholder & Investor Relations

  • Maintain strong relationships with investors, financial analysts, financial institutions, auditors, the SET, SEC, and other regulatory authorities.
  • Represent the company at investor relations events, including Opportunity Day, analyst meetings, and roadshows.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and manage the Finance and Accounting organization.
  • Develop and strengthen the capabilities of the finance team to meet best-in-class organizational standards.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in finance and/or accounting, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership or executive role.
  • Meet the qualification requirements of the SEC Thailand for the highest-ranking finance/accounting executive (CFO) of a listed company, including:
  • Relevant accounting or finance experience as prescribed by SEC regulations.
  • Completion of Continuing Professional Development (CPD) training in accounting (minimum six hours annually).
  • No disqualifying characteristics under SEC regulations.
  • Proven experience working with companies listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand, with strong knowledge of:
  • SEC and SET regulations
  • Public Limited Companies Act
  • Thai Civil and Commercial Code relating to corporate governance
  • Strong knowledge of financial regulations, taxation, financial reporting requirements, and compliance frameworks.
  • Professional certifications such as CPA or CFA, together with CPD qualifications, will be an advantage.
  • Solid experience in budgeting, financial planning, and forecasting.
  • Excellent analytical skills with strong business acumen.
  • Proficient in ERP systems, databases, and Microsoft 365.
  • Demonstrated leadership capability with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Good command of both written and spoken English.

job.title: Regional Sales Manager

Known globally for innovative design and cutting-edge IoT technology, the company operates a lean, agile business model in Southeast Asia, supported by a strong regional headquarters in Singapore.

(Note: Candidates strictly from F&B/food consumable backgrounds are not applicable due to differing buyer personas and sales cycles).

job.title: Financial Controller
job.description:
Job Description
As Financial Controller, you will play a key role in overseeing the hotel’s financial health, operational efficiency, and long-term financial planning. The position requires a hands-on leader with strong analytical capabilities and the ability to support strategic decision-making across the business.
Key responsibilities include:

  • Directing the hotel’s financial operations and supporting overall business performance
  • Supervising financial reporting activities to ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery
  • Developing and strengthening internal control procedures to protect company assets and ensure compliance
  • Leading, mentoring, and developing the finance team while promoting a high-performance culture
  • Evaluating and approving capital expenditure requests in accordance with business priorities and investment strategies
  • Maintaining strong working relationships with external stakeholders including banks, auditors, and tax authorities
  • Partnering with the General Manager and Executive Leadership Team to support operational and financial objectives

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm's Healthcare Division is partnering with a growing Pharmaceutical company to hire a Product Manager to be based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

The Product Manager will be responsible for overseeing the lifecycle of pharmaceutical products, from development to commercialization. This includes managing the product portfolio, strategic planning, market analysis, and working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, regulatory, and R&D teams. The role requires a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical market, strong project management skills, and the ability to drive product success in a competitive environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Planning:

  • Develop and implement product strategies in alignment with overall business goals.
  • Collaborate with senior management to define product positioning, market access strategies, and pricing strategies.
  • Monitor and analyze industry trends, competitor products, and regulatory developments to ensure product success and compliance.

Product Lifecycle Management:

  • Manage the product lifecycle from development to launch, ensuring products meet market needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with R&D and regulatory teams to guide products through development stages, clinical trials, and approvals.
  • Ensure timely product launches by managing timelines, resources, and key stakeholders.

Market Analysis & Consumer Insights:

  • Conduct in-depth market research to identify customer needs, competitive landscape, and potential opportunities for product improvement or expansion.
  • Gather and analyze feedback from customers, sales teams, and healthcare professionals to refine product offerings.

Sales & Marketing Support:

  • Support the development of product positioning and messaging that highlights the product's unique value proposition.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to the sales team to ensure they are equipped to effectively promote the product.
  • Track and analyze product performance, customer feedback, and sales trends to inform future strategies.

Financial Performance & Budgeting:

  • Monitor the financial performance of the product portfolio, including revenue, costs, and profitability.
  • Manage product budgets and collaborate with finance to ensure efficient allocation of resources.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Business, Marketing or a related field.
  • Experience in the therapeutic area relevant to the Obstetric & Gynaecology or Orthopaedics is preferred
  • 3-5 years of experience in product management, brand management, or related roles within the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, product lifecycle management, and market dynamics.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including regulatory, marketing, and sales.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

job.title: Operations Manager (WWI)
job.description:
Executive search firm Monroe Consulting Group Philippines is recruiting on behalf of a company that focuses on trading, importing and finishing of building materials. Our respective client is seeking for an Operations Manager who will be responsible for overseeing and integrating the company’s end-to-end operations, ensuring alignment with executive objectives, operational efficiency, and sustainable business growth. The role serves as a key liaison to senior management and provides strategic direction across logistics, supply chain, sales operations, customer service, and administration. This role has an onsite and field work requirement in Mandaue City, Cebu and will be reporting to the COO and CEO.

Tasks and Responsibilities:
  • Executive & Operational Governance: Partner with company executives to translate business strategies into actionable operational plans, provide performance updates and recommendations, and oversee the implementation of key policies and initiatives.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Lead and align department heads and supervisors across Warehouse & Logistics, Sales & Showrooms, Purchasing/Supply Chain, Customer Service, and Administration to achieve shared business goals and operational standards.
  • Supply Chain & Logistics Management: Oversee warehousing, inventory management, material flow, fulfilment, and logistics activities for projects, distributors, showrooms, and direct clients while ensuring timely and quality delivery.
  • Performance & Process Improvement: Establish and monitor KPIs, operational costs, lead times, and resource utilization. Identify process gaps, eliminate operational waste, reduce costs, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Quality & Compliance: Drive adherence to SOPs, QMS standards, safety requirements, statutory regulations, and corporate policies. Lead root-cause analysis and corrective actions to address recurring operational issues.
  • People & Resource Management: Lead, mentor, and evaluate managers and supervisors while overseeing manpower planning, resource allocation, and capacity requirements to support business growth and operational continuity.
  • Stakeholder & Issue Management: Promote cross-departmental accountability, resolve operational conflicts, and ensure timely escalation and resolution of issues that may impact customers, profitability, or business performance.


Job Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in any Business-related courses. Master’s degree is preferred.
  • 10 years of experience in operations with 5 years in leadership capacity.
  • Proven track record in managing multi-channel operations (B2B Projects, Wholesale, Retail, Supply Chain) within the furnishing, finishing materials, construction, or interior fit-out industry
  • Excellent ability to communicate, negotiate, and align with Business Owners and top management.
  • Deep expertise in end-to-end supply chain, warehouse management, project logistics, and inventory control systems (ERP/WMS).
  • Strong decision-making capability, change management skills, and crisis leadership.

job.description:
Director of Resident Care - RN - Assisted Living Facility
Du Lac Assisted Living Worcester, MA
Description

Director of Resident Care - RN Licensed Registered Nurse Required Notre Dame du Lac Assisted Living Worcester, MA
Student Loan Repayment and Tuition Reimbursement up to $5,250 /year; federal tax-exempt

Who We Are:
Notre Dame Health Care Center, Inc. (NDHCC) deeply rooted in the heritage of the Sisters of Notre Dame de Namur, is committed to the physical, spiritual, and emotional care of our residents and patients. Located off the shores of Lake Quinsigamond within the woods of the Worcester Land Trust, our 5 Star rated nationally recognized Assisted Living, Skilled Nursing Care, Hospice Care, and Educational Bridge Center provide high-quality compassionate care to the Central MA community.

Position Overview:
Adhering to NDHC’s mission and values, the Resident Care Director directs the delivery of all resident care while maintaining compliance with state, federal guidelines. Responsibilities include the following: supervision and development of department employees, care management, serve as member of organizations management team, development of strategic planning and quality assurance initiatives. This role directly supervises, motivates and encourages all resident care staff. An unwavering focus on customer service and resident and family relations are critical. The Director will lead by example with unwavering customer service demonstrated by healthy and thriving resident and family relationships.

Work Hours and Schedule Expectations:
Typical workday hours are Monday through Friday from 8:30 AM to 5:00PM.
Employee within this position not expected to work paid holidays.
Position is ultimately responsible for the Resident Care Department 24 hours a day.

Requirements
· Graduate of an accredited school of nursing (RN), BS preferred
· Current/Nursing license in the state of Massachusetts
· A minimum of five years of clinical experience, working with memory care and assisted living residents.
· Ability to work well with other professionals and communicate effectively.
· Proven leadership skills from past employment professional organizations.
· Knowledge/ Understanding of EOEA regulations required.
· Knowledge of professional nursing theory and practice needed to give and evaluate resident care.
· Knowledge of organizational policies, regulations, and procedures to administer resident care.
· Knowledge of medical equipment and instruments to administer resident care.
· Knowledge of common safety hazards and precautions to establish a safe work environment.
· Skill in applying and modifying the principles, methods, and techniques of professional nursing to provide on-going resident care.
· Skill in preparing and maintaining resident records, writing reports, and responding to correspondence.
· Skill in developing and maintaining department quality assurance
· Skill in establishing and maintaining effective working relationships with residents, medical staff, and the public.
· Ability to maintain quality control standards
· Knowledge of budget process
· Ability to react calmly and effectively in emergency situations
· Ability to interpret, adapt, and apply guidelines and procedures
· Ability to communicate clearly (both verbally and in writing) in English

job.title: Chief Operating Officer
job.description:
Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial & Construction sector to hire a Chief Operating Officer (COO). This opportunity is based in Selangor, Malaysia.
Position Overview
Lead the overall business operations to drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, profitability, and customer satisfaction across the organisation.
Provide executive leadership in shaping operational and commercial strategies while ensuring profitable project delivery, strong governance, and long-term business competitiveness.
Key Responsibilities
Business & Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the company's operational strategy aligned with corporate vision and business objectives.
  • Drive sustainable revenue growth, profitability, operational excellence, and market competitiveness.
  • Lead annual business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and strategic initiatives.
  • Identify new business opportunities, partnerships, and market expansion strategies.
  • Provide strategic recommendations to the Group CEO and Executive Management on business performance and future direction.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead the overall operations of the business, including Engineering, Project Management, Fabrication, Installation, Procurement and Logistics.
  • Ensure projects are completed within budget, timeline, quality, and safety requirements.
  • Establish operational governance, performance management systems, and business KPIs.
  • Drive productivity improvement, operational efficiency, and cost optimisation initiatives.

Commercial & Financial Performance

  • Own the overall Profit & Loss (P&L) performance.
  • Drive business profitability through effective project execution, cost control, productivity improvement, and resource optimisation.
  • Review tender strategies, project pricing, commercial risks, and contract negotiations.
  • Monitor project profitability, cash flow, working capital, and operational budgets.

Project & Customer Delivery

  • Provide executive oversight on all roofing, façade cladding, architectural metal, and steel structure projects.
  • Ensure effective project governance from tender award through project completion.
  • Resolve major project, contractual, commercial, or operational issues.
  • Maintain strong relationships with key clients, consultants, architects, developers, contractors, and strategic partners.

Health, Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Champion a strong safety culture across workshop and site operations.
  • Ensure compliance with CIDB, DOSH, ISO, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Lead incident investigations and corrective action implementation.
  • Drive quality management and continuous improvement programs.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, architects, developers, and contractors.
  • Participate in project meetings and strategic customer engagements.
  • Ensure high customer satisfaction through effective project delivery.
  • Support business development initiatives by providing technical and operational expertise.

People Leadership

  • Lead and develop project managers, engineers, supervisors, site teams, and support functions.
  • Establish succession plans and capability development programs.
  • Drive a performance-oriented culture with clear accountability.
  • Foster collaboration across departments.

Strategic Growth

  • Identify opportunities to expand operational capabilities and market presence.
  • Evaluate new technologies, fabrication methods, and installation techniques.
  • Support expansion into regional projects in line with company growth ambitions.

Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Architecture, or related field.
  • Possess at least 15-20 years of experience in construction, roofing, façade, cladding, steel structures, or building materials industries and minimum 10 years in a senior leadership position.
  • Proven track record of managing full business operations with accountability for P&L, operational performance, and strategic growth.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Demonstrated experience managing Engineering, Project Management, Fabrication, Installation, Procurement and Logistics functions.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in tender strategies, project pricing, commercial risk assessment, and contract negotiations.
  • Proven expertise in driving project profitability, cash flow management, working capital optimisation, and operational budget control.
  • Experience establishing operational governance frameworks, performance management systems, and business KPIs.
  • Strong understanding of roofing, façade cladding, architectural metal, and steel structure projects.
  • Knowledge of CIDB, DOSH, ISO, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Experience leading quality management, incident investigations, corrective action implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to evaluate and implement new technologies, fabrication methods, and installation techniques.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Excellent command of English, with the ability to communicate and deliver presentations effectively.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead both direct teams and cross-functional departments, integrating complex initiatives across multiple business areas.
  • Exceptional organisational and time management skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to drive business growth, operational excellence, and organisational transformation.
  • Ability to foster collaboration, accountability, and a high-performance culture across the organisation.

job.title: Marketing Manager
job.description:

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Marketing Manager. This opportunity is based in Klang, Selangor.
Position Overview
Lead the development and execution of strategic marketing initiatives to strengthen brand positioning, market presence, and business growth within the building and construction industry.
Drive brand performance, customer engagement, and commercial success through effective marketing, specification activities, stakeholder partnerships, and team leadership.
Key Responsibilities

  • Explore and identify strategic business partner to enhance roofing offer to the market.
  • Market and specify products in the Building, Roofing & Construction industry.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with agencies and external vendors to drive performance. Review feedback and learnings from campaigns with agencies for continuous improvement.
  • Manage all marketing activities within the marketing budget and target.
  • Develop and execute marketing strategy for the company to meet the target.
  • Serve as an internal event consultant, strategizing and managing end-to-end logistics for brand and product events to meet business objectives.
  • Understand brand objectives and identify opportunities to enhance branding and engagement through innovative brand activation programs. Initiate new ideas and concepts to drive brand objectives.
  • Collaborate with the Sales & Marketing Director to strategize, develop, and implement comprehensive marketing plans, from creative ideation to execution of both offline and online brand activation programs.
  • Lead and manage the development of key campaigns targeting specific audiences, from budget planning and campaign ideation to managing end-to-end logistics for go-to-market execution.
  • Manage and lead the marketing and technical marketing (specification) team members to achieve desired results. Address issues and barriers affecting the implementation of brand projects and formulate effective action plans.
  • Develop, implement, and manage social media strategies. Define key social media KPIs, oversee social media content, and ensure effective engagement.
  • Support and collaborate with internal stakeholders. Analyze and create post-mortem reports on all marketing campaigns to measure success and gain insights.

Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience

  • Candidate must possess Bachelor's Degree/Post Graduate Diploma/Professional Degree in Marketing/ Sales/ Business Management or equivalent.
  • At least 8 Year(s) of collective working experience in Sales and Marketing background and 4 Years of managerial experience in brand/product management/marketing, preferably in the Building Material/Construction industry.
  • Proven track record of delivering top-line results and meeting marketing KPIs (driving share and penetration).
  • Proven experience in implementing brand and execution plans.
  • Agency management experience (advertising/digital/media agency).

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong understanding of marketing, product specifications, sales, and finance to drive brand performance.
  • Experience in leading specifying and technical marketing with the architectural community is advantageous. Candidates with a network of architects are encouraged to apply.
  • Experience liaising with Pertubuhan Akitek Malaysia (PAM) is preferred.
  • Marketing Communication (MARCOM) is fundamental.
  • Experience developing and executing marketing strategies, brand activation programmes, and go-to-market campaigns.
  • Experience managing social media strategies, social media KPIs, content development, and engagement initiatives.
  • Ability to manage marketing budgets, campaign performance analysis, and post-mortem reporting.
  • Experience working with agencies and external vendors to drive marketing performance.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Ability to lead a direct team and a multifunctional organization, integrating complex efforts across multiple business areas.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with a high attention to detail.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.

  • Comfortable working on both routine and ad-hoc requirements.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities simultaneously.
  • This position requires job-related travel.

job.title: Administrative Assistant
job.description:
An executive recruitment company, Monroe Consulting Group is partnering with an international non-profit organization to hire an Administrative Assistant to support its East Malaysia Project Team in the implementation and coordination of program activities.

The successful candidate will provide administrative, logistical, documentation, reporting, and stakeholder coordination support to ensure the smooth delivery of training programs, workshops, meetings, and other project initiatives. This is a remote-based position located in East Malaysia, with travel required within Malaysia and regionally as needed.

Job Responsibilities:

Program & Project Support

  • Support the planning, coordination, and implementation of project activities, training programs, workshops, and events.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, partners, trainers, speakers, and facilitators to ensure smooth project execution.
  • Monitor program progress against established targets and timelines.
  • Support continuous improvement of program processes and activities.

Stakeholder Engagement & Coordination

  • Build and maintain positive relationships with government agencies, NGOs, partners, and other project stakeholders.
  • Coordinate meetings, training sessions, workshops, and other stakeholder engagements.
  • Serve as a key point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with trainers, speakers, facilitators, and external resource persons.

Research, Data & Reporting

  • Conduct desktop research related to human trafficking and forced labor.
  • Collect, organize, and analyze program data to support monitoring and evaluation.
  • Conduct and analyze pre- and post-training assessments.
  • Support quarterly and annual reporting, work plans, evaluations, and program updates.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date program records and databases.

Documentation & Administration

  • Prepare meeting minutes, letters, reports, presentations, briefings, and other project documentation.
  • Maintain accurate records of program activities, expenditures, outcomes, and supporting documents.
  • Support data quality checks and ensure timely updates to program databases.
  • Assist with payment requests, expense reports, procurement documentation, and other administrative processes.

Events & Logistics

  • Coordinate logistics for training programs, workshops, meetings, and project activities.
  • Support venue arrangements, travel, accommodation, transportation, materials, and equipment requirements.
  • Assist with itinerary planning and logistics for staff visits and external stakeholder meetings.
  • Liaise with Finance and Administration teams to ensure timely processing of payments and expenses.

Budget & Resource Management

  • Support program budgeting, procurement, and allocation of resources.
  • Monitor program-related expenditure and ensure appropriate documentation.
  • Assist in ensuring resources are utilized efficiently within approved budgets.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Social Sciences, Political Science, International Relations, Communications, or a related field.
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in administration, program coordination, project support, NGO, government, or related environments.
  • Experience working with government agencies and/or NGOs is preferred.
  • Understanding or experience relating to human trafficking and forced labor is highly advantageous.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Malaysia.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint; database management experience is an advantage.
  • Demonstrated experience in administrative and logistical coordination, particularly for meetings, workshops, conferences, or training programs.
  • Experience supporting budget management, procurement, expense reporting, and resource coordination.
  • Strong organizational skills with excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote/home-based or field-based environment.
  • Willingness to travel within East Malaysia and regionally as required.
  • Preference will be given to candidates based in East Malaysia.

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Professional Services industry to hire a Marketing and Communications Copywriter. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

The Marketing and Communications Copywriter plays a vital role in strengthening the organisation's position as a leader in its sector through strategic, high-quality communications and content creation.

The role contributes to preserving and enhancing the organisation's culture, reputation, and brand presence by delivering engaging content across multiple communication channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Integration: Collaborating with the Content Specialist and the Advancement team to integrate all social media and digital content plans with overall marketing and advancement objectives.

  • Authentic Community Storytelling: Proactively sourcing, capturing, and generating authentic, in-the-moment content, including developing short-form video scripts (Reels/Stories) and photo captions, highlighting the student and faculty experience.
  • Quality Control and Proofreading: Serving as the final quality control for all public-facing text, meticulously proofreading and editing to ensure impeccable grammar, adherence to brand style guides, and complete factual accuracy.
  • Policy Compliance: Ensuring all social media content strictly complies with school privacy policies regarding student, employee, and community members' photo/video usage.
  • Other Duties: Performing other related duties as assigned.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in any field.
  • Preferably with at least 5 years of related experience.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • High-quality writing and content production delivered with speed and precision, demonstrating the ability to quickly grasp and produce content across diverse subject areas.
  • Demonstrates strong oral and written communication skills in English with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Skilled at tailoring written communication to meet the needs of diverse audiences with varying levels of language proficiency and subject expertise.
  • Significant experience in writing in various formats and for a range of techniques under the PR/content umbrella, including social media, blogs, advertorials, newsletters, video scripts, media releases, and feature stories.

  • Extensive experience in using automated marketing platforms, email marketing services, social media management, and optimisation platforms.
  • Understanding of PDPA requirements related to marketing and digital communications.
  • Experience in creating content for websites, blogs, EDMs, social media channels, digital campaigns, marketing materials, and corporate communication assets.
  • Understanding of SEO techniques and content optimisation.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Social Chameleon: The ability to switch tones effortlessly, from interviewing a Middle School student to a senior faculty member or responding to a concerned parent online.
  • Empathy & Inclusivity: A warm personality that makes people feel comfortable being filmed or photographed, with a strong appreciation for diversity and inclusion in an international setting.

  • Prioritisation: Strong judgement to determine which tasks require immediate attention and which can be scheduled for later.

  • Feedback Resilience: Ability to accept creative feedback from multiple stakeholders and incorporate it constructively into the final output.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills with the ability to engage a diverse range of stakeholders.

job.title: Construction Engineer - Post-tensioned building or bridge projects
job.description:
Job Role: Construction Engineer
Responsibilities:
  • Handle site operations, including planning project work schedules and controlling project costs.
  • Assist Managers and Senior Engineers in preparing Site Activity Reports (SAR) and prepare bi-weekly or monthly Progress Reports for submission.
  • Conduct resource planning for manpower, materials, and equipment required for the project.
  • Liaise with clients on-site regarding work-related matters.
  • Review shop drawings from the Design Department and clients to address any on-site construction issues.
  • Troubleshoot on-site problems to minimize delays and reduce additional costs.
  • Ensure compliance with quality standards and assist in coordinating inspections and documentation within assigned site scopes.
  • Support the Site Manager in identifying non-conformities and assisting in their resolution with reference to project specifications.
  • Provide technical and practical support to Supervisors and Foremen during construction activities.
  • Monitor material wastage and on-site productivity to reduce wastage.
  • Ensure compliance with the company’s IMS processes and procedures.
  • Conduct OSH risk assessment and implement EMS impact & aspect registers.
  • Maintain comprehensive records of all construction-related site activities, including work progress, resource usage, and daily operations.
  • Ensure that relevant QA/QC documents (e.g., inspection reports, test results) are completed and submitted as part of regular site reporting.
  • Carry out procurement of materials and equipment in accordance with company policies and delegated authority.

Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering.

  • At least three (3) years of relevant experience in post-tensioned building or bridge projects is an advantage.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Independent, resourceful, diligent, and able to work effectively as part of a team.
  • Willing to be assigned to project sites anywhere in the Philippines as required.

job.title: Senior Area Sales Manager
job.description:
Senior Area Sales Manager, BU Egg

Location: Malaysia

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment Firm, is partnering with a leading organisation within the Industrial sector to hire a Senior Area Sales Manager, BU Egg based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

Lead the growth and commercial performance of the company's egg business unit by developing business opportunities, driving sales strategies, and strengthening market presence across the region.
This role plays a critical part in achieving revenue, profitability, and market share objectives while supporting product development, customer engagement, and regional collaboration initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the Company's Egg sales-related activities including developing new business, growth strategies and opportunities and maximising long-term profitable volume growth.
  • Realise sales budget (target) both in volume, margin and market share.
  • Analyse the market and determine the sales strategy including a market-specific pricing policy.
  • Participate in generating "Proven Solutions", sales manuals, product and solution templates for proposals, meetings, workshops and other specific sales material.
  • Recommend and take part in trade shows and other relevant marketing projects.
  • Resolve customer complaints regarding sales and service and manage key client relationships.
  • Recommend and implement detailed annual sales operating plans and preparation of sales performance reports for strategic analysis and review on a monthly or quarterly basis.
  • Collect and share product ideas/market requirements. Actively participate in the design of BU Egg related products in collaboration with the customer solutions, engineering and HQ.
  • Assist in the roll out of new products to the relevant countries in our region.
  • Assist and lead the project sales with consulting on farm management level.
  • Determine training requirements for BU Egg sales team.
  • Liaise with respective Asia regions to conduct BU Egg product trainings regionally.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Animal Production or any other equivalent qualification.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in investment goods with relevant experience as a Sales Manager with P&L responsibilities.
  • Those with sales production or sales engineering experience in the fields of agriculture shall be favourably considered.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Proven ability to develop new business, growth strategies and market opportunities.
  • Experience in achieving sales budgets covering volume, margin and market share targets.
  • Strong market analysis and sales strategy development capabilities, including pricing strategy formulation.
  • Experience in developing sales materials, solution proposals, sales manuals and product templates.
  • Ability to prepare detailed annual sales operating plans and sales performance reports for strategic review.
  • Experience in product development collaboration with customer solutions, engineering and head office stakeholders.
  • Exposure to new product rollout initiatives across multiple countries.
  • Experience leading project sales and providing farm management-level consultation.
  • Knowledge of training needs assessment and sales capability development programmes.
  • Ability to work across regional teams to coordinate and conduct product training programmes.
  • Willingness and ability to travel within the Asia region.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Excellent business acumen with a proven business track record.
  • Excellent networking and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive and able to work independently.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong leadership and coaching skills with evidence of building, retaining and motivating a high-performing sales team.

job.title: Government Relations Specialist (East Malaysia)
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Professional Services sector to hire a Government Relations Specialist, East Malaysia. This opportunity is based in East Malaysia.

Position Overview
The role spearheads strategic advocacy and external engagement efforts with key stakeholders in East Malaysia. It directly contributes to strengthening justice system responses and advancing policy frameworks to protect vulnerable workers.

Key Responsibilities


  • Coordinate and implement advocacy and external engagement efforts with key stakeholders in East Malaysia, ensuring alignment with strategies set by the Government Relations Manager.

  • Provide strategic input to the Program Support Specialist on stakeholder engagement, advocacy and policy reform opportunities.

  • Guide the team to ensure strategic external engagements that lead directly to project outcomes.

  • Develop and implement advocacy strategies aligned with IJM’s Protection Model, Advocacy Goals and Program Goals for East Malaysia.

  • Develop strategy and plans to activate stakeholders to influence the government on forced labour and labour trafficking issues.

  • Prepare background, strategic insights, plans and briefing documents toward advocacy and engagements with government, private partners, local and global development communities.

  • Ensure East Malaysia strategies and insights are communicated regularly to the Government Relations Manager for integration into national policy and systems change strategies.

  • Adapt national level advocacy frameworks to the East Malaysia context.

  • Remain up to date on policy reforms, media reports and relevant trends on national and state levels.

  • Map and engage key stakeholders with influence over labour protection and anti-trafficking efforts in Sabah and Sarawak.

  • Identify, facilitate, and manage strategic collaborations with government, civil society, and private sector partners.

  • Represent the organisation in meetings, forums, and coalitions to promote justice system improvements.

  • Facilitate multi-stakeholder dialogues, roundtables, and joint initiatives to promote systemic change.

  • Contribute to the development of training materials and advocacy resources.

  • Document lessons learned and best practices for internal and external knowledge sharing.

  • Provide capacity-building trainings in collaboration with programme teams and relevant specialists.

  • Maintain comprehensive records of strategic relationships, project activities, and advocacy outcomes.

  • Track progress against advocacy goals and contribute to quarterly and annual reporting.

  • Engage in regular coordination meetings with the Government Relations Manager to ensure harmonisation of national and East Malaysian strategies.

  • Provide timely updates and flag emerging political or stakeholder issues.

Key Requirements


  • Qualifications & Experience

  • Master’s degree in relevant field preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in humanities, social work, law, human rights, international development or related field, or equivalent work experience.

  • At least 5 years of experience in project development and implementation with diverse government and community-based groups.

  • Capacity-building experience desirable.

  • Strong knowledge of current issues on human trafficking, forced labour, international trafficking instruments and labour trafficking laws.

  • In-depth knowledge of federal and state government structures and dynamics.

  • Proven ability to work well at an inter-personal level with government and non-government stakeholders.

  • Established experience in networking with stakeholders across community spectrum.

  • Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Fluent in spoken and written English and Bahasa Malaysia.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Developed organisational and leadership skills, superior attention to detail, exceptional follow-through and accountability for results.

  • Excellent time management and ability to work effectively under deadline pressures.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound judgement.

  • Experience working independently in remote or decentralised settings.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, cross-cultural communication, and ability to foster good working relations.

  • Flexible, enthusiastic, and willing to receive feedback and learn from others.

  • High level of honesty and integrity.

  • Courageous and humble servant leader.

  • Passion and commitment for the mission and theory of change.

job.title: PERM Director of Nursing
job.description:
Director of Nursing Services (DON)

Full-Time | Exempt
Schedule: 40 hours per week
Salary: $125,000-$150,000 annually

About the Role

Our client is seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing Services (DON) to lead our highly regarded, 5-star rated skilled nursing center. Unlike many traditional long-term care settings, Brookhaven's intimate 12-bed nursing center offers the opportunity to build meaningful relationships with residents, families, and staff while maintaining a strong focus on clinical excellence, quality outcomes, and person-centered care.

This is a highly visible leadership role for a nursing professional who enjoys being actively engaged with residents and staff while providing strategic direction for nursing operations. The Director of Nursing Services is responsible for the overall direction, administration, and clinical oversight of Nursing Services, including quality improvement, regulatory compliance, staffing, professional development, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

Reporting directly to the Executive Vice President/Chief Operating Officer & Nursing Home Administrator, the DON plays a key role in supporting Brookhaven's commitment to excellence, dignity, and resident-centered care. While this position is primarily focused on leadership and oversight rather than routine floor coverage, the ideal candidate is a hands-on leader who is willing to step in and provide clinical support when needed.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Direct and oversee all Nursing Services operations.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, and local regulations, including Department of Public Health requirements.
  • Lead quality assurance and performance improvement initiatives.
  • Oversee resident assessments, care planning, nursing documentation, and clinical outcomes.
  • Manage staffing, scheduling, recruitment, retention, and employee development.
  • Foster a culture of person-centered care, resident satisfaction, dignity, and respect.
  • Oversee infection prevention and control programs.
  • Collaborate with physicians, residents, families, and interdisciplinary team members to ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain nursing policies, procedures, and standards of practice.
  • Manage departmental budgets and resources effectively.
  • Ensure employee safety, staff education, orientation, and ongoing training requirements are met.
  • Serve as a clinical resource and provide direct nursing support as needed.
  • Support organizational goals and participate in committees, strategic initiatives, and community activities.
  • Other related duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Current Registered Nurse (RN) license in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing (BSN) from an accredited nursing program.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of nursing leadership experience in a skilled nursing facility, long-term care setting, or similar healthcare environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Massachusetts long-term care regulations and survey processes.
  • Demonstrated success in staff leadership, quality improvement, and regulatory compliance.
  • Excellent communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Prior Director of Nursing experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care community.
  • Experience leading interdisciplinary teams and managing departmental budgets.


Why Brookhaven:

At Brookhaven, you'll find the unique combination of a close-knit nursing community and the resources of a well-established continuing care retirement community. Our 5-Star rated skilled nursing center is known for its commitment to exceptional care, strong survey performance, and dedicated team members who take pride in serving residents with dignity and compassion.

This position offers the opportunity to lead a small, highly engaged nursing team where your leadership can have a direct and meaningful impact on residents, families, and staff. If you are looking for a role that allows you to focus on quality care, mentor nursing staff, remain connected to residents, and contribute to an organization that values excellence and collaboration, Brookhaven may be the perfect fit.

Brookhaven offers competitive compensation, subsidized medical, dental and vision insurance, generous paid time off, and participation in a retirement plan with company match.

job.title: R&D Chemist
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire an R&D Chemist. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

This role supports pilot-scale R&D trials in edible oil refining and modification, delivering accurate chemical and instrumental analysis to underpin process development. It plays a direct part in advancing the organisation's innovation agenda across edible oils, fats, oleochemicals, biodiesel and renewable fuels.

Key Responsibilities

You will contribute directly to the organisation's technology development by generating accurate analytical data, supporting both pilot- and lab-scale process trials, and participating in innovation projects across edible oils, fats, oleochemicals, biodiesel, and renewable fuels.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Assist to laboratory and pilot-scale trials in edible oil refining, modification and oleochemical processes.
  • Participate in the preparation, execution, monitoring and reporting of R&D experiments.
  • Conduct chemical and instrumental analysis with our state-of-the-art analytical equipment.
  • Validate and apply official analytical methods in line with industry standards.
  • Ensure proper calibration, maintenance records, and laboratory documentation are kept up to date.
  • Manage laboratory chemicals, consumables and inventory in compliance with internal and regulatory requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Lead the implementation of laboratory safety protocols (chemical handling, waste management, PPE compliance, risk assessments).
  • Ensure the analytical and sample preparation areas are fully compliant with HSE standards.
  • Conduct periodic safety training and ensure safe operation of all analytical equipment.
  • Work closely with process engineers, R&D engineers, group specialists and external partners (universities, institutes, customers).

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Prior experience in a laboratory or R&D environment, ideally within edible oils, fats, oleochemicals or a related process industry.
  • Experience supporting or leading laboratory safety protocols and HSE compliance is advantageous.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong hands-on skills in operating, maintaining and troubleshooting analytical equipment.
  • Solid understanding of chemical analysis related to edible oils and fats (FFA, DOBI, peroxide value, fatty acid profile, moisture, stability, etc.).
  • Ability to validate and apply official analytical methods in line with industry standards.
  • Knowledge of laboratory safety practices and chemical management, including calibration, maintenance records and documentation.
  • Experience managing laboratory chemicals, consumables and inventory in compliance with internal and regulatory requirements.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Accurate, detail-oriented and able to produce reliable analytical data under time constraints.
  • Strong critical thinking and structured reporting skills.
  • Ability to lead the implementation of safety protocols and conduct periodic safety training.
  • Effective collaborator, able to work closely with process engineers, R&D engineers, group specialists and external partners such as universities, institutes and customers.

job.description:
Technical Manager

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Senior Technical Manager. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

The Technical Manager will oversee the technical, financial and operational delivery of maintenance and project activities, ensuring works are completed to specification, on schedule and within budget. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding the organisation's operational integrity, regulatory compliance and long-term asset reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  1. To strictly follow and adhere to all Company policies and approved procedures on business ethics, SSHE and others.
  2. Manage the financial aspect of all maintenance works and projects following the approved budget.
  3. Responsible for the maintenance and project from inception to completion of jobs, meeting the technical requirement, schedule and budget.
  4. Liaise with Contractors and Consultants on various maintenance works and projects.
  5. Assist with requirements in relation to site preparation and associated consultations.
  6. To assist in procurement of spare parts, consumables and equipment and ensure that the procurement procedure is followed, meeting the technical specification and budget.
  7. To participate in technical discussions internally as well as with customers, suppliers, contractors and authorities, during the tender review, technical clarifications and site meetings.
  8. To develop and execute a preventive maintenance plan on critical equipment and monitor the implementation.
  9. To attend to maintenance problems arising from daily operational activities.
  10. To plan, monitor, execute and maintain calibration records and certificates of fitness of critical equipment.
  11. To strictly comply with the Company's HSSE regulations when carrying out maintenance activities. In the absence of the Company's as well as government regulations on maintenance activities to be carried out, best practice rules apply.
  12. To play an active role in the Emergency Response Team, ISO9001:2008 and Safety Committee.
  13. Any other duties and responsibilities as delegated by the General Manager and immediate superior.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or professional qualification in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil or a related discipline), or equivalent industry experience.
  • Proven experience in a technical/maintenance management role within an industrial, terminal or process operations environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing maintenance and project works from inception through to completion, including budget and schedule accountability.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong working knowledge of maintenance planning, project management and financial/budget control for maintenance and project works.
  • Experience in procurement processes for spare parts, consumables and equipment, ensuring alignment with technical specifications and budgetary requirements.
  • Proficiency in developing and executing preventive maintenance plans for critical equipment, including monitoring of implementation.
  • Experience in calibration planning, execution, record-keeping and maintaining certificates of fitness for critical equipment.
  • Sound knowledge of SSHE/HSSE regulations, company policies and best practice standards applicable to maintenance activities.
  • Familiarity with ISO9001:2008 quality management systems.
  • Experience participating in tender reviews, technical clarifications and site meetings with customers, suppliers, contractors and authorities.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management and liaison skills, with the ability to engage effectively with contractors, consultants, customers, suppliers and authorities.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to respond promptly to maintenance issues arising from daily operations.
  • Strong organisational and multitasking abilities to manage competing priorities across maintenance and project portfolios.
  • High level of integrity and commitment to business ethics, safety and compliance standards.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for internal and external technical discussions.
  • Active and collaborative approach to emergency response and safety committee participation.
  • Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgement, particularly in the absence of specific regulatory guidance.
